The firm is led by its founder and CEO, Mr. Ahmed Al Farsi, an experienced professional in the field of accounting and business advisory. International To Organize Accounts specializes in a wide range of services, including:

  • Accounting Services: Offering comprehensive bookkeeping and accounting solutions, including preparation of financial statements, general ledger maintenance, and financial reporting.
  • Audit Services: Conducting internal and external audits to ensure businesses meet regulatory requirements and financial standards.
  • Taxation Services: Providing expert tax consultancy, including VAT and corporate tax compliance, helping clients minimize liabilities and adhere to local tax laws.
  • Business Consulting: Offering strategic advice to improve operational efficiency, enhance profitability, and support business growth.
  • Payroll Management: Managing payroll services for companies, ensuring accurate and timely salary processing, along with compliance to labor laws.
  • Financial Planning and Forecasting: Assisting businesses with financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting to ensure long-term financial stability.

International To Organize Accounts has earned a strong reputation for delivering exceptional services tailored to the unique needs of its clients. With a focus on accuracy, transparency, and timely service, the company continues to support businesses across various industries in maintaining financial health and achieving sustainable success.

BMS Auditing is a prominent auditing and accounting firm based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Established in 2013, BMS Auditing has rapidly gained recognition for providing comprehensive and reliable financial services to businesses in the UAE and beyond. The firm is led by its CEO, Mr. Mohamed Ali, who has extensive experience in auditing, accounting, and financial consulting. BMS Auditing specializes in the following areas:

  • Audit Services: Conducting statutory audits, internal audits, and compliance audits to ensure that businesses adhere to financial regulations and standards.
  • Accounting Services: Offering tailored accounting solutions, including bookkeeping, financial statement preparation, and tax accounting.
  • Tax Consultancy: Providing expert advice on VAT, corporate tax, and other local tax regulations, helping businesses optimize their tax liabilities.
  • Business Advisory: Offering strategic financial advice to companies for better decision-making and growth.
  • Financial Consultancy: Helping businesses with financial planning, forecasting, and reporting to ensure efficient management of resources.
  • Forensic Accounting: Detecting and investigating fraud and financial discrepancies within companies to mitigate risks and maintain compliance.

With a strong reputation for professionalism, attention to detail, and deep industry knowledge, BMS Auditing has built long-lasting relationships with clients from various sectors, including retail, construction, and hospitality. The firm's commitment to delivering quality financial services has made it a trusted partner for businesses looking to maintain transparency, compliance, and sustainable growth.

PwC Middle East is the regional branch of PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), a global leader in professional services. Located across multiple countries in the Middle East, with offices in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and others, PwC Middle East serves a wide range of industries in the region. The firm was established in 1970 and has grown to become one of the most prominent business consultancies in the Middle East. The current CEO of PwC Middle East is Mr. Jassim Al-Sadoun. PwC Middle East specializes in the following areas:

  • Audit and Assurance: Providing independent auditing services and helping businesses comply with financial reporting requirements.
  • Tax Services: Offering comprehensive tax advice, including corporate tax, indirect tax, transfer pricing, and international tax planning.
  • Consulting Services: Delivering expert guidance in areas such as strategy, operations, technology, and management to help clients improve performance.
  • Deals and M&A: Advising clients on mergers, acquisitions, restructuring, and other corporate transactions.
  • Risk Assurance: Helping organizations identify, manage, and mitigate risk in their business processes, systems, and strategies.
  • Forensics and Investigation: Offering forensic services to detect and prevent fraud, corruption, and financial misconduct.

PwC Middle East continues to play a vital role in shaping the business landscape of the region, offering businesses of all sizes the expertise and tools they need to grow and adapt in an increasingly complex global market. With a commitment to innovation, excellence, and delivering value to clients, PwC Middle East remains a trusted advisor for corporations, governments, and other stakeholders across the region.

RockShield Properties is a dynamic real estate company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Founded in 2019 by CEO Mr. Muhammad Ali, the company has quickly established a reputation for excellence in the UAE’s competitive property market. RockShield Properties specializes in providing a comprehensive range of real estate services, including:

  • Residential property sales and rentals, offering a variety of high-quality apartments, villas, and townhouses across Dubai
  • Commercial real estate services, including the leasing and sale of office spaces and retail properties
  • Property management, helping property owners effectively manage their real estate investments with a focus on maintenance, leasing, and tenant relations
  • Investment advisory services, offering clients strategic insights and solutions for maximizing returns in the UAE property market
  • Real estate consultancy, providing professional advice on property development, market trends, and investment opportunities

With its commitment to customer satisfaction and its comprehensive portfolio of services, RockShield Properties has become a trusted name in the UAE real estate industry. The company continues to grow, offering clients tailored solutions and unmatched expertise, making it an ideal partner for individuals and businesses looking to invest in the thriving Dubai property market.

Prowin Properties LLC is a well-established real estate company located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Founded in 2012 by Mr. Raheel A. Khan, Prowin Properties has quickly made a name for itself in the competitive real estate market of the UAE. The company is known for its customer-centric approach and dedication to delivering high-quality services to both property buyers and investors. Prowin Properties specializes in the following areas:

  • Residential sales and rentals, offering a wide variety of properties including apartments, villas, and townhouses
  • Commercial real estate services, helping businesses find ideal office spaces and retail properties
  • Property management services, providing comprehensive solutions for property owners to maintain and lease their investments
  • Real estate consultancy, offering expert advice on market trends, investment opportunities, and property valuations
  • Investment opportunities, assisting clients in identifying profitable real estate investments with high returns

Prowin Properties is committed to excellence in service and strives to provide innovative real estate solutions that meet the needs of its diverse clientele. With its strong track record of successful transactions and satisfied clients, Prowin Properties continues to grow as a trusted real estate partner in Dubai, offering valuable insights and tailored solutions in the dynamic UAE property market.

DAMAC Properties is a leading luxury real estate developer based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Established in 2002 by Hussain Sajwani, a prominent Emirati businessman, the company has grown to become one of the most recognized names in the Middle East’s real estate sector. The CEO of DAMAC Properties is Mr. Hussain Sajwani, who remains an influential figure in the company’s leadership. DAMAC Properties specializes in several key areas within real estate development, including:

  • Luxury residential developments, offering high-end apartments, villas, and penthouses
  • Commercial properties, including office buildings and mixed-use developments
  • Hospitality projects, with luxury hotels and resorts operated under brands like Versace, Bugatti, and Paramount Hotels & Resorts
  • Integrated lifestyle communities, providing a range of services and amenities for residents and businesses
  • Real estate investment, focusing on long-term value and high returns for investors

DAMAC Properties is renowned for its iconic, opulent designs and its ability to create sophisticated living spaces. Through its strategic partnerships with global luxury brands, the company has set a high standard in the UAE and Middle Eastern real estate markets. DAMAC's focus on innovation, quality, and luxury ensures its continued success and strong position in the global real estate industry, shaping the skyline of Dubai and contributing to the region’s economic growth.

Sobha Realty is a prominent luxury real estate developer based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The company was established in 1976 by PNC Menon, an Indian entrepreneur, and has grown into one of the leading developers in the UAE. The current CEO is Mr. PNC Menon, who continues to lead the company with a vision of excellence and quality. Sobha Realty specializes in a variety of sectors within the real estate industry, including:

  • Luxury residential developments, including high-end apartments, villas, and townhouses
  • Commercial real estate, providing office spaces and business hubs in prime locations across Dubai
  • Integrated township developments, offering a combination of residential, commercial, and recreational spaces in a single community
  • Real estate investment, focusing on properties with high rental yields and long-term growth potential
  • Hospitality projects, developing luxury hotels and resorts
  • Construction and design, maintaining a reputation for high-quality materials and craftsmanship

Sobha Realty is known for its commitment to quality, innovative designs, and meticulous attention to detail in all of its developments. The company has built a strong reputation for delivering exceptional projects that enhance the Dubai skyline and provide high-end living experiences. Through its ongoing dedication to luxury and sustainability, Sobha Realty continues to contribute significantly to Dubai’s real estate sector, solidifying its place as a leader in the industry.

Dubai Holding is a global investment conglomerate based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and a key player in the city's economic landscape. It was established in 2004 by His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai. The current CEO of Dubai Holding is Mr. Amit Kaushal. The company specializes in a wide range of sectors, including:

  • Real estate development, managing iconic projects such as Jumeirah Beach Hotel and Business Bay, among others
  • Hospitality, operating several luxury hotels and resorts under brands like Jumeirah Group
  • Telecommunications and media, with investments in various digital platforms and telecom businesses
  • Investments in finance, including banking services and private equity
  • Leisure and entertainment, supporting major global and regional events and attractions
  • Sustainability initiatives, focusing on environmental responsibility and green technologies

Dubai Holding plays a vital role in shaping the future of Dubai through its diverse portfolio of assets, investments, and ventures. With a strong emphasis on innovation, sustainability, and luxury, the conglomerate continues to drive the growth of the UAE's economy and cement Dubai's position as a global business hub. Its broad expertise across industries ensures Dubai Holding remains a pivotal force in transforming the city's landscape for years to come.

Emirates is a world-renowned international airline based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It was established in 1985, under the guidance of the Dubai government, with the support of the late Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the ruler of Dubai. The airline is currently led by Sheikh Ahmed bin Saeed Al Maktoum, who serves as the Chairman and CEO of Emirates Group. Specializing in a wide range of services, Emirates includes:

  • International passenger flights, connecting more than 150 destinations across six continents with a fleet of modern, fuel-efficient aircraft
  • Cargo services, providing airfreight solutions through Emirates SkyCargo to facilitate global trade
  • Premium travel experiences, offering first-class, business class, and economy class services with luxurious amenities, such as private suites and onboard lounges
  • In-flight entertainment, providing passengers with award-winning entertainment through ICE (Information, Communication, Entertainment) systems
  • Travel packages and tourism, offering complete travel solutions including vacation planning, hotel bookings, and car rentals
  • Airline catering, managing catering services through Emirates Flight Catering, providing high-quality meals to passengers on various international flights

Emirates has grown to become one of the largest and most respected airlines globally, known for its exceptional customer service, innovation, and commitment to quality. It continues to strengthen Dubai's position as a global aviation hub, contributing significantly to the UAE's economy. Through its dedication to excellence and expansion, Emirates remains at the forefront of the airline industry, constantly pushing the boundaries of air travel to enhance the passenger experience.

DP World is a global leader in logistics and port management, headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Established in 2005, DP World was formed through the merger of Dubai Ports International and the Dubai Ports Authority. The company is currently led by Sultan Ahmed Bin Sulayem, the Chairman and CEO. DP World specializes in a range of services across the logistics and maritime sectors, including:

  • Port operations and management, operating a vast network of container terminals across the world
  • Terminal and logistics services, providing integrated solutions that streamline global supply chains
  • Inland and rail logistics, offering transportation solutions beyond ports, connecting key hubs
  • Maritime services, including ship management, customs clearance, and freight forwarding
  • Trade facilitation, supporting international trade with efficient and secure systems
  • Innovation in digital logistics, leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency and enhance customer experience

DP World has become a critical player in the global trade and logistics industry, known for its advanced infrastructure, cutting-edge technology, and commitment to sustainable practices. With operations spanning across six continents, the company continues to drive global trade forward, strengthening its position as a key player in the maritime and logistics industries. Through its continuous investment in innovation and expansion, DP World remains at the forefront of transforming global trade and logistics, contributing significantly to economic growth worldwide.

Muhaisnah Centre is a prominent shopping and commercial center located in the Muhaisnah area of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. While the specific establishment date and founder's details are not publicly available, it has become a well-established destination for retail, dining, and community services in the region. The centre caters to the needs of both residents and visitors, offering a range of amenities and facilities. Its specializations include:

  • Retail services, featuring a mix of local and international brands across fashion, electronics, and household goods
  • Dining options, with various restaurants and cafes offering diverse cuisines to suit all tastes
  • Supermarkets and convenience stores, providing everyday essentials to the community
  • Entertainment facilities, including recreational and leisure activities
  • Community services, with a focus on family-friendly offerings and local events
  • Healthcare and wellness, with medical clinics and fitness centers available on-site

Muhaisnah Centre has built a reputation as a hub for shopping and leisure, contributing to the vibrant lifestyle of Dubai’s eastern neighborhoods. With its convenient location and broad range of services, it continues to be a popular choice for both shopping and socializing, ensuring its position as a key retail center in the region.

The Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) Group is a leading integrated energy company based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Established in 1971, ADNOC was founded by the late Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the founding father of the UAE. Today, the company is led by Dr. Sultan Ahmed Al Jaber, the CEO, and Minister of Industry and Advanced Technology for the UAE. ADNOC specializes in a wide range of operations within the oil and gas industry, including:

  • Exploration and production of oil and natural gas, focusing on both conventional and unconventional energy sources
  • Refining, producing refined petroleum products and petrochemicals for local and global markets
  • Distribution and retail, with a vast network of gas stations and fuel services across the UAE
  • Shipping and storage, managing a significant fleet of vessels and storage facilities for crude oil and refined products
  • Natural gas processing, supplying cleaner energy solutions for the UAE and international markets
  • Renewable energy, with investments in solar, wind, and hydrogen energy to diversify the energy mix
  • Research and development, innovating to improve operational efficiencies and reduce environmental impacts

ADNOC Group is one of the world's largest and most valuable integrated energy companies, with a strategic focus on maximizing value for its shareholders while contributing to the economic development of the UAE. Through its commitment to sustainability, technological advancement, and global partnerships, ADNOC continues to play a pivotal role in the energy sector. As the company adapts to a rapidly changing energy landscape, it remains a cornerstone of the UAE's economic strength and a leader in the global energy market.

SEO Sherpa is a digital marketing agency based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, specializing in search engine optimization (SEO) and online marketing solutions. Established in 2017, SEO Sherpa was founded by a team of digital marketing experts with a passion for helping businesses increase their online visibility and achieve sustainable growth through organic search. The CEO, [Founder’s Name], has been at the helm of the company, driving innovation and leading the agency to success in a competitive market. SEO Sherpa specializes in:

  • Search engine optimization (SEO), improving website rankings and driving organic traffic through on-page and off-page SEO strategies
  • Pay-per-click (PPC) advertising, managing campaigns on platforms like Google Ads and Bing Ads to drive targeted traffic
  • Content marketing, creating valuable content that enhances brand presence and engagement with target audiences
  • Social media marketing, helping businesses build and manage their social media presence on platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter
  • Web design and development, offering responsive and SEO-friendly website designs that improve user experience and conversion rates
  • Local SEO, optimizing websites for local search results and increasing visibility for businesses in specific geographical areas

SEO Sherpa has established itself as a trusted partner for companies seeking to improve their digital footprint, attract more customers, and grow their online presence. With a focus on data-driven strategies and personalized service, SEO Sherpa continues to deliver measurable results for clients across various industries. Their commitment to staying ahead of SEO trends and utilizing the latest tools and techniques ensures their continued success in the fast-evolving digital marketing landscape.

First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the largest bank in the United Arab Emirates, headquartered in Abu Dhabi. It was established in 2017 through the merger of two prominent institutions, National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) and First Gulf Bank (FGB), creating a powerhouse in the UAE’s banking sector. The current CEO, Hana Al Rostamani, has been instrumental in leading the bank’s growth and diversification. FAB specializes in a variety of financial services, including:

  • Retail banking, offering a range of products such as savings accounts, personal loans, mortgages, and credit cards
  • Corporate banking, providing tailored financial solutions for businesses, including trade finance, working capital management, and business loans
  • Investment banking, with services in asset management, advisory, and private equity
  • Wealth management and private banking, catering to high-net-worth individuals with bespoke financial services and investment opportunities
  • Treasury services, including foreign exchange, cash management, and risk management solutions
  • Islamic banking, offering Sharia-compliant financial products and services
  • Digital banking, providing cutting-edge online and mobile banking services to enhance customer experience

FAB has solidified its position as a financial leader in the UAE and the wider region, with a strong emphasis on innovation, customer service, and sustainability. The bank's ongoing efforts to expand its reach internationally, coupled with its commitment to excellence in financial services, ensure its role as a key player in the global banking industry. With a focus on delivering value to customers and stakeholders, FAB continues to drive forward in the competitive banking landscape.

Lux-Sar Properties is a prominent real estate company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Established in 2008, the company has grown to become one of the leading firms in the UAE’s real estate sector, providing high-quality services in both residential and commercial properties. Lux-Sar Properties was founded by a team of experienced real estate professionals, with the CEO currently leading the company to new heights of success in a highly competitive market. The company specializes in:

  • Residential real estate, offering a wide range of properties including luxury villas, apartments, and townhouses
  • Commercial real estate, providing office spaces, retail properties, and mixed-use developments
  • Property management services, focusing on maintenance, leasing, and tenant management
  • Real estate investment consulting, advising clients on lucrative investment opportunities in Dubai’s growing property market
  • Sales and leasing services, assisting clients in buying, selling, and renting properties
  • Interior design and renovation services, offering expert solutions for residential and commercial spaces

Lux-Sar Properties has built a reputation for its commitment to customer satisfaction, transparency, and quality in every aspect of real estate. With a strong presence in the Dubai property market, the company continues to grow its portfolio and maintain its position as a trusted partner for clients seeking premium properties and investment opportunities. Its focus on innovation, professionalism, and tailored services ensures its continued success in the highly dynamic real estate landscape of the UAE.

Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is the government-owned utility provider in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, responsible for the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity and water. Established in 1992, DEWA was formed to meet the growing demand for these essential services in the rapidly developing city of Dubai. The CEO and Managing Director of DEWA is Saeed Mohammed Al Tayer, who has led the organization through various initiatives focused on innovation, sustainability, and growth. DEWA specializes in:

  • Electricity generation, transmission, and distribution, ensuring a stable and reliable power supply across Dubai
  • Water desalination, providing potable water to the residents of Dubai through state-of-the-art desalination plants
  • Renewable energy, with significant investments in solar power through initiatives like the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park
  • Smart grid technology, modernizing the electricity network for more efficient energy management
  • Sustainability, implementing green initiatives aimed at reducing the carbon footprint and promoting environmental responsibility
  • Infrastructure development, investing in power plants, substations, and water facilities to support Dubai’s growing population and economy

DEWA plays a vital role in supporting Dubai’s infrastructure and contributing to its status as a global business hub. The authority’s dedication to innovation, sustainability, and efficiency has made it a leader in the utility sector, with a strong focus on maintaining the highest standards of service. With a forward-thinking approach and commitment to meeting future energy needs, DEWA continues to be an integral part of Dubai’s ambitious growth plans.

Etihad Airways is the national airline of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), headquartered in Abu Dhabi. Established in 2003 by a royal decree from His Highness Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the airline was founded with the aim of establishing Abu Dhabi as a major global aviation hub. The airline’s CEO, Tony Douglas, has led the company through significant growth and expansion in international markets. Etihad Airways specializes in:

  • International passenger services, operating flights to over 100 destinations worldwide, offering both economy and premium services
  • Cargo and freight services, providing logistics solutions and air cargo transportation for various industries
  • Aircraft leasing and management through its subsidiary, Etihad Airways Engineering, which also provides maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services
  • Strategic partnerships with other global airlines, as part of its codeshare agreements and alliances
  • Hospitality and luxury services, including premium cabins such as The Residence, First Class, and Business Class on its long-haul flights

Etihad Airways has quickly grown into one of the most respected airlines in the world, renowned for its innovative services, luxury offerings, and exceptional customer experience. By maintaining a strong focus on safety, sustainability, and service quality, Etihad has cemented its place as a leader in global aviation. The airline’s strategic growth, alongside its ability to adapt to the changing demands of the aviation industry, ensures its continued success in the highly competitive global air travel market.

Dubai Islamic Bank (DIB) is a leading Islamic banking institution based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Established in 1975, DIB was the first bank in the UAE to offer Sharia-compliant financial services, making it a pioneer in Islamic banking. The bank was founded by His Highness Sheikh Ahmed bin Saeed Al Maktoum, and its current CEO is Dr. Adnan Chilwan, who has played a significant role in steering the bank toward modern banking solutions while maintaining adherence to Islamic principles. Dubai Islamic Bank specializes in a wide range of banking services, including:

  • Retail banking, offering savings accounts, personal loans, mortgages, and credit cards that comply with Islamic law
  • Corporate banking, providing Sharia-compliant financing solutions to businesses, including trade finance, project financing, and working capital facilities
  • Investment banking, with services such as asset management, private equity, and corporate advisory
  • Islamic insurance (Takaful), offering Sharia-compliant insurance products for individuals and businesses
  • Digital banking, providing online and mobile banking solutions for seamless, secure transactions
  • Treasury and wealth management services, catering to high-net-worth individuals and institutional clients

Dubai Islamic Bank has established itself as a key player in the UAE's banking sector, playing a crucial role in the growth of Islamic finance both locally and internationally. Its strong commitment to ethical banking, innovation, and customer satisfaction has made it one of the most trusted financial institutions in the region. DIB’s continuous focus on modernizing its services while staying true to its Islamic roots ensures its prominent position in the financial industry, helping shape the future of banking in the UAE and beyond.

Emaar Properties is a globally recognized real estate development company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Established in 1997 by His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, Emaar has become a leading force in the development of iconic residential, commercial, and mixed-use properties. The company is currently led by CEO Ahmad Al Matrooshi, who has guided Emaar’s expansion into international markets. Emaar specializes in a variety of sectors, including:

  • Residential developments, with luxurious communities such as the renowned Emirates Hills, Downtown Dubai, and Arabian Ranches
  • Commercial real estate, focusing on high-end office buildings, business parks, and corporate hubs
  • Retail, owning and operating some of the largest shopping malls in the world, including The Dubai Mall
  • Hospitality, with investments in hotels and resorts under globally recognized brands such as Armani Hotels and Address Hotels
  • Leisure and entertainment, offering world-class attractions such as the Dubai Fountain, Dubai Opera, and various theme parks
  • Real estate management and investment, with projects spanning across the Middle East, North Africa, and beyond

Emaar has significantly contributed to shaping Dubai's skyline and transforming it into a global destination for business, tourism, and luxury living. Its commitment to quality, innovation, and excellence has made it one of the most reputable names in real estate worldwide. With its diverse portfolio and strategic approach to growth, Emaar continues to play a pivotal role in the development of Dubai’s urban landscape and the broader real estate sector.

ALDAR Properties is a leading real estate development company based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Established in 2004, ALDAR has grown to become one of the most prominent players in the UAE’s real estate sector, known for its high-profile residential, commercial, and retail developments. The company was founded by His Highness Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the late President of the UAE, and is currently led by CEO Talal Al Dhiyebi. ALDAR specializes in a wide array of real estate services, including:

  • Residential development, creating both luxury and affordable housing communities across the UAE
  • Commercial and office spaces, including iconic buildings and business hubs in Abu Dhabi and beyond
  • Retail properties, with numerous shopping malls and retail outlets, such as Yas Mall and Al Jimi Mall
  • Master-planned communities, focusing on integrated urban developments that blend living, work, and leisure spaces
  • Infrastructure projects, contributing to the development of key urban infrastructure in Abu Dhabi and the broader region
  • Sustainability and green building practices, with a focus on energy-efficient, eco-friendly designs and developments

ALDAR Properties has established itself as a key driver of Abu Dhabi’s urban development, creating landmark projects that have shaped the city’s skyline and infrastructure. With a commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability, the company continues to play an instrumental role in the UAE’s real estate landscape. Its diverse portfolio, strong financial position, and strategic approach to growth ensure that ALDAR remains a leader in the development and management of real estate in the region.

Majid Al Futtaim is a renowned conglomerate based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, known for its significant contributions to the retail, real estate, and entertainment industries. Established in 1992 by its founder Majid Al Futtaim, the company has become a leading player in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. The current CEO of Majid Al Futtaim is Alain Bejjani, who has guided the company through its global expansion and innovation in various sectors. Majid Al Futtaim specializes in several key areas, including:

  • Retail, with a dominant presence in supermarkets, hypermarkets, and convenience stores, operating popular brands such as Carrefour across the MENA region
  • Real estate development, including shopping malls, mixed-use communities, and leisure destinations such as Mall of the Emirates and City Centre malls
  • Leisure and entertainment, offering cinema experiences through Vox Cinemas and other entertainment facilities
  • Financial services, including insurance and credit card offerings through partnerships with leading banks
  • Sustainable and innovative solutions in energy management, waste reduction, and eco-friendly construction practices

Majid Al Futtaim’s strategic focus on diversification and its commitment to creating value for customers, communities, and shareholders has made it a trailblazer in multiple industries. The company is recognized for its ability to adapt to market trends, invest in cutting-edge technology, and provide outstanding consumer experiences. With its strong commitment to innovation, sustainability, and economic growth, Majid Al Futtaim continues to play a significant role in shaping the future of the retail and real estate sectors in the region.

e& UAE, formerly known as Etisalat Group, is a leading telecommunications company based in the United Arab Emirates. Established in 1976, it is one of the largest telecom operators in the Middle East, providing comprehensive services to both individual consumers and businesses. The company is headquartered in Abu Dhabi, UAE, and is led by CEO Hatem Dowidar, who has played a pivotal role in steering the company towards digital transformation and innovation. e& UAE specializes in a wide range of services, including:

  • Telecommunications services such as mobile, internet, and fixed-line services for both individuals and businesses
  • Digital transformation solutions, including cloud computing, Internet of Things (IoT), and cybersecurity services
  • Business solutions, offering enterprise services like managed IT, data centers, and connectivity solutions
  • Media and entertainment services, with offerings in digital TV, IPTV, and mobile content
  • Financial technology (FinTech) services, including digital payments and mobile banking solutions
  • 5G and broadband network development, focusing on the rollout of cutting-edge, high-speed mobile networks

e& UAE has established itself as a key player in the region’s technological and digital evolution, offering innovative services that cater to the growing demand for connectivity and digital solutions. The company’s commitment to providing advanced, reliable services has solidified its position as a leading telecommunications provider not just in the UAE, but across the Middle East. Through continuous investment in next-generation technologies and services, e& UAE remains at the forefront of the region’s telecom industry, helping shape the future of digital communication.

Mubadala Investment Company is a state-owned investment vehicle based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Established in 2002, Mubadala operates as a global investment and development firm focused on advancing the economic diversification of the UAE. The company was founded by His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi, and is currently led by CEO Khaldoon Al Mubarak. Mubadala specializes in a wide range of sectors, including:

  • Energy, focusing on oil, gas, and renewable energy investments
  • Aerospace, with significant investments in companies such as the Emirates Group and Strata Manufacturing
  • Technology, including investments in digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence
  • Healthcare, with ventures in medical technology and services
  • Real estate and infrastructure, including major development projects both in the UAE and internationally
  • Financial services, managing large-scale funds and portfolios across various global markets
  • Industrial development, focusing on manufacturing and the production of high-value goods

Mubadala is a key player in the UAE’s economic transformation, actively working to diversify the country’s revenue sources beyond oil and gas. Through its strategic investments in high-growth sectors, the company supports innovation, sustainability, and long-term economic prosperity. With a focus on global partnerships and sustainable development, Mubadala continues to drive forward-thinking initiatives that not only benefit the UAE but also have a global impact across industries.

Sharjah Islamic Bank (SIB) is a prominent financial institution based in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, offering a wide range of Sharia-compliant banking services. Established in 1975, SIB has grown to become one of the leading Islamic banks in the UAE, providing both personal and corporate financial solutions. The current CEO of Sharjah Islamic Bank is Mr. Mohammed Abdalla, who has played a key role in steering the bank towards growth and innovation. Sharjah Islamic Bank specializes in a variety of services, including:

  • Retail banking, offering personal accounts, loans, credit cards, and mortgages, all in compliance with Islamic principles
  • Corporate banking, providing financing, trade services, and cash management for businesses and enterprises

Shape the Future with RAKBANK

About Danat Al Emarat Hospital

Danat Al Emarat Hospital, part of the M42 Group, is a leading specialty hospital dedicated to women’s and children’s healthcare in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

The hospital is recognized for providing high-quality medical care, advanced technology, and a patient-focused healthcare experience for families across the UAE and beyond.

Danat Al Emarat is the only private women and children’s hospital in the UAE with a dedicated Fetal Medicine Department and a fully equipped Level III Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), providing advanced care for premature and critically ill newborns.

The hospital is also recognized as a regional referral center for high-risk pregnancies and complex maternal and neonatal care.

  • Obstetrics and Gynecology

  • Fetal Medicine

Patient-Centered Care

To provide a comfortable experience, the hospital also offers:

About Tribert Rujugiro Ayabatwa and PTG-HLD

Tribert Rujugiro Ayabatwa founded PTG in 1978 in Burundi with a vision to build a strong African-owned manufacturing company. What started as a small manufacturing business has grown into one of the largest indigenous consumer goods companies in Sub-Saharan Africa.

His vision has always been to build a company that not only focuses on business growth but also helps improve the lives of families and communities.

Commitment to Social Impact

Ayabatwa is also widely known for his philanthropic work and dedication to helping communities become more self-sufficient. Through partnerships with local communities and public institutions, PTG-HLD supports initiatives that contribute to long-term development and better livelihoods.

For more than 40 years, PTG-HLD has continued to grow as a leading African manufacturing company while staying committed to innovation, economic development, and community empowerment across Sub-Saharan Africa.

Our Story

TriVita was founded from a life-changing personal experience that led to a new purpose.

Our founder, Michael Ellison, lived a very fast and high-pressure life for many years. He worked long hours, pushed himself hard, and often rested very little. Over time, this lifestyle affected his health deeply.

One day, during a hike in Arizona, he experienced severe chest pain and feared he was having a heart attack. This moment made him realize that success means very little without health and inner balance.

Medical tests showed that his nervous system was completely exhausted. Doctors advised him to slow down, rest, and change his lifestyle. This became a turning point in his life.

A Journey Toward Wellness

From that experience, Michael began a journey to rebuild his health—physically, mentally, and emotionally.

He discovered that true health is more than just not being sick. It includes energy, peace of mind, purpose, joy, and overall balance in life.

He also believed in the importance of caring for the body and living in harmony with a healthy lifestyle and positive habits.

The Foundation of TriVita

These life lessons became the foundation of TriVita.

The company was created to help people improve their overall well-being through better daily habits, nutrition, and a more balanced lifestyle.

What started as one person’s healing journey has now become a mission to help many people live healthier, more meaningful lives.

We aim to help people live with more energy, positivity, and purpose in their daily lives.

Shaping the Future of Applied Education

At the Higher Colleges of Technology (HCT), we are committed to preparing talented Emirati professionals who can contribute to the UAE's future growth and development. To support this goal, we have introduced a new strategic plan, "Shaping the Future 2023–2028," designed to transform applied education and align it with the country's vision, economic priorities, and global best practices.

Our strategy is built around three core pillars: Inclusivity, Integration, and Sustainability.

Inclusive Education for All Learners

We believe every student should have access to educational opportunities that match their abilities, interests, and career goals.

To support a wider range of learners, HCT introduced a new Vocational Diploma pathway alongside the existing Applied Bachelor's programs. This pathway includes 12 new specialized programs developed based on industry needs and future workforce demands.

As a result, student enrollment has grown significantly, with the HCT community now serving more than 25,500 students across the UAE.

Strong Industry Partnerships

A key focus of our strategy is strengthening collaboration with businesses, employers, and industry partners, particularly within the private sector.

These partnerships help create valuable opportunities for students through internships, practical training, and employment pathways. By working closely with employers, we ensure that our programs remain relevant to the evolving needs of the job market.

HCT has established partnerships with numerous organizations, creating thousands of training and career opportunities for students and graduates.

Supporting National Workforce Development

As part of our commitment to supporting the UAE's workforce development goals, HCT works closely with the Emirati Talent Competitiveness Council (NAFIS).

Through the Health Program initiative, high school graduates are prepared for careers in healthcare and health sciences, helping meet the growing demand for qualified professionals in the private healthcare sector.

Today, hundreds of students are pursuing studies in health-related fields through this initiative, building the skills needed to support the nation's healthcare system.

Learning Through Real-World Experience

To better prepare students for successful careers, HCT introduced the Apprenticeship Program, which combines academic learning with practical workplace experience.

Through this program, students gain hands-on experience by working directly with partner organizations while continuing their studies. This allows them to apply classroom knowledge in real-world environments, develop professional skills, and build valuable industry connections.

More than 2,000 students have already benefited from this innovative approach to learning and career preparation.

Looking Ahead

As we continue our journey, our goal is to graduate future-ready professionals who can work, innovate, lead, and contribute positively to society.

We are committed to continuously improving our academic programs by:

  • Strengthening partnerships with industry and employers
  • Expanding practical and work-based learning opportunities

Building the Future Together

Through the "Shaping the Future" strategy, HCT is redefining applied education in the UAE. By combining academic excellence with practical experience and industry collaboration, we are helping students develop the skills, knowledge, and confidence needed to succeed in a rapidly changing world.

Our mission is simple: to empower the next generation of professionals who will help shape a stronger, more innovative, and more sustainable future for the UAE.

Changing the Mind Space
With over 20 years of experience and a team of 10+ skilled clinicians, Eva & Iris is the first premium home care service for mental health in the UAE.

Mental health challenges can take many forms and affect your happiness, satisfaction, and overall quality of life. While some people manage through self-help, others may need professional guidance. At Eva & Iris, you don’t have to face it alone—we bring expert mental health care directly to your home or a private space, making support convenient, confidential, and accessible.

A Fresh Approach to Mental Health
The founders of Eva & Iris, with decades of experience in healthcare, recognized the need for a more accessible and private mental health solution. They wanted to move away from traditional clinic-based care and make mental wellbeing support easier and more comfortable for everyone. This vision led to the creation of the UAE’s first home-based mental health service, addressing the diverse needs of the country’s multicultural population.

Our Commitment: Respect, Dignity, and Empathy
We believe effective mental health care requires a safe, supportive, and understanding environment. Our services are designed to respect your personal space, ensure privacy, and make you feel comfortable while receiving professional care.

Our Strength: Experienced Professionals
Our team of psychologists, therapists, and counsellors brings over 20 years of collective experience. With diverse backgrounds, cultural understanding, and expertise, our clinicians are dedicated to guiding you toward improved mental wellbeing and a more fulfilling life.

Vision
To be the go-to choice for mental wellbeing for individuals across the world.

Mission
To empower people to live life to the fullest by providing exceptional, convenient, and personalized mental health care.

Our History
The journey of Juma Al Majid Holding Group began in 1950, when H.E. Juma Al Majid founded his first company. From these humble beginnings, the Group has grown into a diversified business conglomerate, contributing to the growth of the UAE for over seven decades. Guided by the principles of simplicity, honesty, and integrity, the Group has expanded its presence across multiple sectors, touching lives across the UAE and beyond.

1950: H.E. Juma Al Majid establishes his first company, laying the foundation of the Group.

1958: Tyres & Batteries division is launched, signing an exclusive agreement to distribute Yokohama Tyres in the UAE.

Over the years, the Group has diversified into contracting, commercial, travel, real estate, and investments, growing steadily while supporting the UAE’s development.

About Our Founder
H.E. Juma Al Majid is a true pioneer whose journey from the hardships of his early life as a pearl diver’s son to building a global business is an inspiring story of vision and perseverance. Beyond business, he is known for his generous support of education and social development both in the UAE and internationally.

Leadership
The Group’s leadership team, guided by H.E. Juma Al Majid, consists of experienced professionals dedicated to innovation, growth, and community impact. Together, they ensure the Group continues to deliver exceptional products, solutions, and services while maintaining the values instilled by its Founder.

Our Philosophy
We are committed to exceeding expectations through:

Service Excellence: Providing high-quality, customer-focused solutions.

Integrity: Acting honestly, ethically, and transparently in every endeavor.

Social Responsibility: Contributing positively to society and the communities where we operate.

Vision & Mission

Vision (2027): To make a meaningful impact in every business we operate.

Mission: To exceed stakeholders’ expectations while upholding excellence in all we do.

Core Values

Leadership: Driving purposeful growth and shaping a better future for the Group.

One Team: Fostering collaboration and treating employees as partners.

Ethics: Maintaining fairness, honesty, and transparency in all activities.

Service Excellence: Ensuring customer satisfaction through proactive and dedicated service.

Our Legacy
For more than 70 years, the Juma Al Majid Holding Group has remained a symbol of trust, resilience, and innovation—continuing to grow while staying true to the principles laid down by its Founder.

From our local roots to a global presence, WSP’s journey is one of growth, innovation, and leadership in professional services. Our Global Presence Today

With operations in over 50 countries across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific, WSP combines global scale with local expertise. Thousands of WSP professionals—known as Visioneers—are united by a shared purpose: to shape communities and advance humanity through innovative and impactful projects.

To be a leading integrated healthcare provider delivering the highest international standards of quality and safety.

To transform healthcare services in the UAE, ensuring world-class medical quality and exceptional patient care.

Diabetes

Respiratory care

Pain management

Wound healing and scars

Anti-infectives

Anemia

Dermatology

Cardiology

At Marriott International, innovation drives everything we do – from serving our guests and supporting our associates to growing our global business. What started in 1927 as a small nine-seat A&W Root Beer stand in Washington, D.C., has grown into one of the world’s leading hospitality companies. Our success is guided by five core values: put people first, pursue excellence, embrace change, act with integrity, and serve our world.

Our Early Beginnings (1927–1956)

Marriott began as an A&W Root Beer franchise, founded by J. Willard and Alice Sheets Marriott. The business grew from serving root beer to offering full meals at “The Hot Shoppes,” laying the foundation for future ventures.

Entering the Hotel Business (1957–1976)

Marriott expanded into lodging with the Twin Bridges Motor Hotel in Arlington, Virginia. Bill Marriott, Jr., son of the founders, took charge of hotel operations, guiding Marriott into the hospitality industry.

Growth and Milestones (1977–1988)

The company celebrated its 50th anniversary in 1977 and broke ground for a new headquarters, marking a major step in Marriott’s global expansion.

Global Expansion (1989–2004)

In 1989, the Warsaw Marriott opened as the company’s 500th hotel. It was the first western-managed hotel in Eastern Europe and the tallest in Warsaw, symbolizing Marriott’s growing international presence.

Lifestyle and Luxury Innovation (2005–2015)

Marriott partnered with hotelier Ian Schrager to launch EDITION Hotels, a luxury boutique brand. The first property opened in Waikiki, Hawaii, in 2010, highlighting Marriott’s focus on innovative and personalized guest experiences.

Becoming the World’s Largest Hotel Company (2016–Present)

In 2016, Marriott acquired Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide, becoming the world’s largest hotel company. This milestone strengthened Marriott’s global footprint and expanded its portfolio of iconic brands, continuing a legacy of excellence and innovation celebrated worldwide.

JESS began in 1975 with just 17 children in a small apartment building. Today, it has grown into a leading international school with two campuses, three schools, and over 2,300 students from around the world.

In the 1970s, many expats came to the Middle East to work in the oil industry. There was a clear need for high-quality, affordable education for the children of English-speaking families. This inspired the creation of JESS near the Deira Clock Tower in Dubai.

Within a year, as student numbers grew, HH Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum generously gifted a plot of land in Jumeirah. JESS moved into a villa there, expanding into one of Dubai’s leading primary schools, which continues to thrive today.

By 2005, the growing demand for school places led to the opening of the Arabian Ranches campus, a modern site offering both primary and secondary education. This gave rise to the model of “three schools, two campuses, one JESS.”

Our success today reflects the vision and foresight of 1975. We continue to work hard to build a lasting legacy for the next generation of JESS students, from humble beginnings to a vibrant international school with two thriving campuses.

Skill-Drill™ is a specialized remedial program designed for children in Grades 5–10 who face learning challenges such as ADHD or cognitive delays (CCD). Indian Curriculum: Focused guidance for CBSE and ICSE students, emphasizing core concepts, progressive learning, and practical understanding.

American Curriculum: Personalized and paced learning aligned with Common Core and state standards to foster real-world readiness and creative thinking.

Global Curricula: Supports students following Canadian, Australian, and UK programs, helping them master core concepts across subjects.

Inclusive & NEP 2020-Compliant Program

Skill-Drill™ is an inclusive, multisensory remedial program designed to strengthen essential academic skills:

Numeracy & Math: Builds a solid math foundation using the concrete–pictorial–abstract (CPA) method, focusing on number sense, logical thinking, and practical applications.

Literacy & English: Enhances reading, writing, spelling, comprehension, and communication skills using phonics, Orton-Gillingham methods, and multi-sensory approaches.

Sensory & Cognitive Skills: Develops attention, memory, sensory regulation, coordination, and classroom readiness through targeted games, fine motor exercises, and cognitive activities.

Program Highlights

Duration: 42 weeks of guided learning

Class Size: 1 tutor : 5 students for personalized attention

Delivery: Live online classes with certified SEN professionals

Support: Performance tracking, test series, and exam simulation

Methodology: Scaffolded, multisensory learning with Universal Design for Learning (UDL)

Why Choose Skill-Drill™

Structured curriculum tailored to each child’s learning pace

Guidance from experienced educators and clinical therapists

Builds confidence, independence, and lifelong learning skills

Focus on numeracy, literacy, and sensory-cognitive integration

Get Started
Book a free Skill-Drill™ diagnostic assessment to see how your child can benefit. Start early, build a strong foundation, and help your child succeed academically with expert support and structured practice.

Our Mission
At Furchild, we help pet parents give their pets a healthier, happier, and more vibrant life by providing easy access to high-quality nutrition and natural products. We believe the saying “you are what you eat” applies just as much to pets as it does to humans.

Our Story
Furchild began in 2013 with a little English Bulldog named Maximus. Like many expats in Dubai, we were focused on our careers, but when we decided to adopt Max, we quickly realized how challenging it was to find proper nutrition for pets. Despite feeding him high-quality commercial dog food and frequent trips to the vet, Max became lethargic, overweight, and suffered from allergies, digestive issues, and skin problems.

Through research and learning about pet nutrition, we discovered that commercial pet foods often contain additives, preservatives, and other ingredients that can harm pets’ health. We switched Max to a fresh, raw diet made from wholesome ingredients, and within weeks, he regained energy, had a healthier coat, cleaner teeth, better digestion, and overall improved well-being.

In 2015, we adopted another English Bulldog, Syema, from a local shelter. He too showed signs of poor nutrition. Switching him to a raw diet brought similar amazing results—weight loss, a softer and shinier coat, fresher breath, and a more energetic and happy pet.

Seeing these transformations inspired us to help other pet owners. We teamed up with international pet nutrition experts, holistic veterinarians, and UAE-based specialists to create Furchild—a pet food company dedicated to making raw, balanced, and nutritious meals easily available.

Our Products
Furchild meals, treats, and bones are made with fresh, ethically sourced Halal meats, organic oils, and locally grown organic vegetables. Our products meet the highest international standards (AAFCO, FEDIAF, NRC) for all life stages. We combine innovation, care, and quality to ensure pets get the nutrition they need to thrive.

Our Journey
With support from local authorities, family, and friends, we launched the first Furchild kitchen in the UAE—a state-of-the-art facility producing meals that transform pets’ lives. Our commitment to honesty, innovation, and pet well-being drives us forward every day.

Thanks to Maximus and Syema, we’ve seen firsthand how proper nutrition can make pets happier, healthier, and more vibrant—and we want every pet parent to experience the same joy.

“May my legacy grow and live on. I hope it enjoys a long and joyful life.”

Gabrielle Chanel lived life entirely on her own terms. From a difficult childhood spent as an orphan to becoming a powerful and successful businesswoman, she developed a bold and unforgettable personality. She was fearless, independent, and far ahead of her time.

Her close friendships, deep love stories, and strong curiosity for art, culture, travel, and new experiences shaped who she was. She rejected excess and restriction, creating a new way of dressing that felt free and modern. Her style blended simplicity with masculine touches, elegance with ease. Pearls worn casually, diamonds without formality, and unforgettable perfumes became her signature.

She was not just a designer, but a pioneer. Her lifestyle, beliefs, and many sides of her personality formed the values of the House she created — values that continue to inspire women around the world today.

Luck: A Personal Belief

When Gabrielle Chanel created her first perfume, she was asked to choose between several samples. She selected the fifth one. When asked what it should be called, she replied that she was presenting her collection on May 5th, the fifth month of the year, and believed the number five would bring her luck. That decision gave birth to the legendary N°5.

Luck played an important role in her life. Friends often wrote to her about it, and she surrounded herself with symbols she believed brought good fortune. An ear of wheat became one of her favorite signs of abundance and hope. It appeared in her home as art and decoration, created by talented artists she admired.

Although Gabrielle Chanel believed strongly in shaping her own destiny, she also paid close attention to symbols and signs. Her birthday, August 19, inspired another fragrance, N°19. The lion, representing her zodiac sign Leo, appeared often in her personal spaces. The star, first seen in the stone floors of her childhood home, followed her throughout her life and later became a bold diamond design in her jewelry collection.

A Liberated Way of Living

Gabrielle Chanel embraced freedom not only in fashion, but in life. In the early 1900s, she chose comfort and movement over convention. She wore trousers, sailor shirts, and kept her hair short — long before this was common for women.

She loved the outdoors and an active lifestyle. She enjoyed the sun, travel, and time spent near the sea. Sports became part of her daily life: horseback riding, skiing, golf, sailing, and fishing. Horse riding, in particular, remained a lifelong passion and influenced both her personal style and her designs.

These experiences inspired clothing that allowed women to move freely — what we now recognize as the foundation of modern sportswear. As she once explained, she designed clothes not because fashion demanded it, but because her life did.

She created fashion for living — and lived fully, boldly, and without apology.

The Rashid Centre for Students of Determination was established in 1994 with the goal of making a real difference in the lives of students with special needs. From the beginning, our mission has aligned with the UAE’s vision of faith, empowerment, employment, and social inclusion for students of determination.

We support children from the age of 4 who have a range of physical, learning, and sensory challenges. Our Centre offers a comprehensive curriculum and a therapeutic approach, including vocational training, which has helped many of our students gain meaningful employment.

Over the years, we have received ongoing support from both public and private sectors through donations, sponsorships, volunteering, and new initiatives. This support has allowed the Centre to grow, evolve, and continue providing high-quality education and care.

Our experienced and dedicated staff design educational and therapeutic programs based on the latest research and best practices. We also collaborate with universities and organizations to ensure our students receive the best possible support.

We invite you to explore our website to learn about our therapies, educational programs, and the activities that make learning at the Rashid Centre enjoyable and enriching.

Admissions

The Rashid Centre serves students with additional learning needs that may make attending a regular school challenging. These needs can include physical, cognitive, and sensory processing challenges.

Before admission, each child undergoes an initial assessment, reviewing previous medical and psychological evaluations. This helps us understand their primary needs and determine the best way to support their learning. Students are admitted only when we are confident that we can meet their individual needs.

Assessment

During the first month at the Centre, our class team observes and assesses each student’s strengths, areas needing support, and learning style. By the end of the month, a full baseline assessment is completed and shared with parents. This assessment informs the student’s Individual Education Plan (IEP) or Individual Training Plan (ITP), setting personalized goals and targets for their growth.

At The Doris Duan-Young Autism Center (DDY), we live by our motto: “Expertise That Cares.” We offer a range of services for children and young adults under one roof, providing multidisciplinary care in a supportive and compassionate environment. Located in Dubai Healthcare City, our 10,063-square-foot facility offers seven key services, including assessment, clinical and therapeutic programs, inclusion and vocational programs, and community and caregiver training.

Since opening in 2014, our dedicated team—comprising Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) and Developmental Psychologists—has supported over 400 families. With unconditional care at the heart of what we do, we have become one of Dubai’s leading autism centers, known for personalized, innovative, and comprehensive care.

Passion – Our work is driven by purpose. We wake up motivated to help People of Determination reach their full potential.

Our History

The center was founded by Doris Duan-Young, a US-based best-selling author who has helped over 20,000 families navigate challenges related to autism and other developmental disabilities since 1994. Through her work with Behavioral Support Services (BSS), Inc and a commitment made via the Clinton Foundation, she established the DDY Autism Center in Dubai.

The Dubai center opened on April 2, 2014, World Autism Awareness Day, carrying on Doris Duan-Young’s legacy of empowering individuals with autism.

Under the leadership of Dr. Ben Hadj Hassine, CEO and Managing Director, the center expanded to Al Razi Medical Complex, adding therapeutic centers, administrative offices, and operations departments. Dr. Ben established strategic partnerships across the GCC, enhanced medical tourism opportunities, and prioritized family education, ensuring parents and caregivers are actively involved in the growth journey of their children.

At Align Health, our goal is to support you every step of the way so you can regain strength, move comfortably, and live better.

Compassionate Care, Always

Community Engagement

Your health is our priority. We take a patient-centered approach, listening to your needs and involving you in healthcare decisions. Your comfort, safety, and peace of mind are always important to us.

Our Impact

At Abdul Aziz Medical Center, we combine expertise, compassion, and a personal touch to ensure every patient receives the care they deserve.

Our Experience
We are a boutique management consulting firm helping SMEs, startups, and entrepreneurs across the MENA region. With a combined experience of over 100 years across multiple industries, we guide our clients through finance transformations and business growth journeys.

Our Approach
We carefully evaluate each project and only take on assignments where we can add real value. By working closely with our clients and integrating into their teams, we ensure every effort moves in the right direction. Our solutions are practical, innovative, and tailored to the unique needs of each business.

Why Choose Us
We believe in personalized guidance. We choose our clients carefully to ensure we can give each one the time, attention, and expertise they deserve. Whether you need the right strategic partner, a specialized skill, or tools to grow your business, we collaborate with you to create and refine a plan for success.

What We Do
Your business is our priority. We help you turn your goals into reality, providing advice, practical support, and strategies to make the most of every opportunity. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to restructure, we guide you through every step.

Our Mantra
We follow a simple philosophy: analyze, identify, advise, execute. Our mission is to build lasting relationships, not one-time transactions. We stay by your side, helping you navigate challenges and seize opportunities.

Our People

We aim to be recognized as a leading homegrown consultancy in the UAE and the trusted advisory partner for SMEs, startups, and entrepreneurs across the MENA region.

We help clients build sustainable ecosystems of people, processes, and funding to unlock hidden advantages and shape the future. By challenging conventional thinking and fostering innovation, we create transformative results that are both distinctive and lasting.

Exclusive Music Education (EME) – A Team of Music Experts

At EME, we are a group of passionate music professionals dedicated to introducing children to the world of music. Our goal is to make music learning fun, inspiring, and meaningful, giving every child the education they truly deserve.

We are a performance-focused music studio, which means our students get many opportunities to perform throughout the year—at school recitals, family gatherings, and video performances. We believe that playing in front of an audience is an important part of growing as a musician.

As former children ourselves, we understand how much fun can enhance learning. That’s why our lessons are designed to be enjoyable, engaging, and full of smiles, creating a positive and encouraging environment for every student.

For those who want to take their skills further, we support exam preparation (ABRSM, Trinity) for students who practice regularly at home. This helps them set clear goals and develop their musical abilities in a focused way.

We also embrace modern music. While classical music is an essential part of our program, our library includes jazz, contemporary, and popular music to suit every student’s taste and age.

Larisa and Vitali are pianists, educators, and the founders of EME. They started the studio as two piano instructors and have since built a growing team of passionate teachers. Both studied Music Education and Piano Performance at the Academy of Music, Theatre and Fine Arts in Moldova and the London College of Music, UK. Alongside teaching, they perform as a piano duo: www.lvpianoduo.com.

Their professional experience taught them a key lesson: practicing and performing should be enjoyable. This belief shaped EME’s music program, which aims to make learning music one of the most memorable and joyful parts of a child’s life. Every teacher at EME follows this philosophy, creating a supportive, motivating, and fun environment for students and families alike.

Our employees are our greatest strength. Their dedication and hard work have played a key role in our success, and we remain committed to supporting their growth as we expand our business.

Looking ahead, we will focus on growth, innovation, and building strong relationships with our clients and partners.

Thank you to our customers, partners, and employees for your continued trust and support.

Dr. Ali Al Mulla
CEO

Trust

Honesty

Integrity

Respect

Dedication

Professionalism

Precision

Transparency

Quality Policy

Vision

To become a leading regional business group that creates value for customers and employees by promoting excellence, encouraging innovation, and contributing positively to society.

Mission

To manage and grow a diverse portfolio of businesses while understanding changing market needs and delivering high-quality solutions through strong leadership and innovation.

Our strong focus on honesty and teamwork has helped us build long-lasting relationships and consistently deliver great value to our clients across the globe.

Investment Management

Our teams help clients reimagine workplaces, find the right spaces, design and build projects, manage properties, and unlock the full value of real estate assets.

Our Mission

Our goal is simple: to help our clients, investors, and people succeed by getting the most out of their properties and real assets.

We encourage our people to:

Fitty is a premium personal training studio located on the mezzanine floor of UW Mall, next to BurJuman in Al Mankhool, Dubai. It is designed for people who prefer privacy, personal attention, and real results from their fitness journey.

Unlike busy gyms, Fitty offers a calm and comfortable space where you can focus completely on your goals. Each client gets one-on-one attention from experienced trainers who understand that everyone’s fitness journey is different.

At Fitty, training is never one-size-fits-all. Every program is customised based on your goals, fitness level, and lifestyle. Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, improve mobility, or simply stay healthy, the trainers create a plan that works best for you. Progress is tracked regularly to make sure you stay on the right path and see lasting results.

Fitty offers a variety of specialised programs for different needs. The Body Recomposition Program helps you lose fat and build lean muscle for a stronger physique. The Senior Fitness Program focuses on improving strength, balance, and mobility in a safe way. For women, there is a Pre and Postnatal Fitness Program designed to support the body during pregnancy and recovery. Fitty also offers a Kids Fitness Program with fun and engaging sessions to help children stay active and healthy.

To make fitness more convenient, Fitty provides its “Anywhere Fitness” option. This allows you to train wherever you feel most comfortable. Trainers can come to your home for private sessions, or guide you in your apartment gym so you don’t have to travel far.

If you enjoy outdoor workouts, Fitty also offers training sessions in parks and open spaces. These sessions focus on functional movements and help improve strength, endurance, and overall fitness while keeping your routine fresh and exciting.

Fitty also works with companies through Corporate Wellness Programs. These programs help employees stay active, reduce stress, and improve overall health, which can also boost productivity at work.

The main focus at Fitty is flexibility, personal care, and long-term results. Whether you train in the studio, at home, or outdoors, every session is built around your personal goals.

If you are looking for a personal training experience in Dubai that offers privacy, expert guidance, and flexibility, Fitty is a great choice. Visit Fitty at UW Mall, next to BurJuman, Al Mankhool, and take the first step toward a healthier and stronger lifestyle. 💪

Zayed University is a leading institution known for its innovative approach to education in the UAE and the region. It was established in 1998 and is named after the country’s founder, Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan. The university reflects his vision and values in its mission. Today, it has modern campuses in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, welcoming students from both the UAE and around the world.

Vision
To be a strong educational institution that reflects Sheikh Zayed’s values while achieving excellence in teaching and research.

Mission
To support the social, cultural, and economic growth of the UAE and beyond through quality education and research. The university encourages open thinking, a love for learning, and a strong sense of community service.

Values

Integrity
We are committed to honesty, transparency, and ethical behavior in everything we do. We aim to build trust and respect within our university community.

Curiosity
We encourage a love for learning and new ideas. Students and staff are motivated to ask questions, explore knowledge, and think beyond traditional limits.

Resilience
We see challenges as chances to grow and improve. We learn from difficulties and use them to become stronger and better.

Compassion
We care about others and try to understand their feelings and experiences. We build meaningful connections and work to make a positive impact in our community.

Sunrise English Private School is one of the well-known and long-standing schools in Abu Dhabi. Established in 1988, the school has over three decades of experience in providing quality education, especially to expatriate Indian students. It follows the CBSE (10+2) curriculum from New Delhi and is recognized as an “A Band” school by ADEK. Under the guidance of Principal Dr. Thakur Mulchandani, the school continues to grow with energy, innovation, and a strong commitment to excellence.

Our Approach to Education

At Sunrise, we focus on creating a safe, caring, and encouraging environment where students can grow in all areas—academically, socially, and emotionally. We aim to provide high-quality education while helping students develop a scientific mindset and stay connected to the cultural values of both India and the UAE.

We encourage students to become independent learners who are confident, responsible, and ready to face the challenges of the modern world.

Learning Experience

Classrooms at Sunrise are active and engaging. Teachers use modern teaching methods that make learning interesting and interactive. Students are encouraged to ask questions, share ideas, and think creatively. Our goal is to build their confidence and help them develop problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

A Global Outlook

We believe every student has unique talents. The school provides many opportunities for students to discover and develop their abilities. Our education system supports the overall growth of students—mind, body, and character—while preparing them to succeed in a global environment.

We inspire students to be curious, think differently, and stand out with their skills and knowledge.

Environmental Responsibility & Parent Involvement

Through eco-friendly programs and school initiatives, we teach students the importance of protecting the environment. We also strongly believe in the role of parents in a child’s success. Their support and active involvement are highly valued and encouraged.

Our Legacy

For more than 30 years, Sunrise English Private School has built a strong reputation for academic excellence and character development. The school continues to uphold high standards while nurturing students to become responsible and capable individuals of the future.

Our Vision

To provide excellent education through teamwork, thoughtful decisions, and continuous improvement, helping students grow into responsible global citizens.

To achieve high academic standards consistently
To support every student’s academic and personal needs
To build strong relationships with parents and the community
To encourage staff development and adapt to change
To provide balanced education focusing on overall growth
To help students respect and understand UAE culture and values

To develop skills like creativity, critical thinking, and independence
To involve all stakeholders in the school’s progress
To create a safe, healthy, and supportive environment for all students

Gulf Education focuses on putting students first by offering a variety of learning options for everyone. Students can study at their own speed and choose online learning, which allows them to follow a path that suits their individual needs.

This is especially helpful for families who travel often, students who are serious about sports, or those who want to study subjects beyond their current grade level. Online education gives learners the freedom to explore more opportunities and learn in a way that works best for them.

Whether a student is homeschooled or attending a regular school, online learning can provide extra support and help them succeed in their studies.

Our Mission
Gulf Education aims to support every student’s unique learning needs and prepare them to become responsible, active members of society in the future.

Our private school in Abu Dhabi is a welcoming international school that offers many opportunities for your child. Our dedicated and experienced teachers work hard to help every student enjoy learning and build strong skills for their future.

As members of the International Schools Partnership (ISP), we are connected to a global network of schools. This allows us to support students in becoming confident, curious learners. We encourage them to take responsibility for their learning while giving them the support they need to succeed in a changing world.

Our Vision
