We follow the National Curriculum for England and welcome students from Early Years to Sixth Form. Today, we have more than 1800 students from over 70 nationalities, making our school a diverse and vibrant community.

Learning at Reach

Your child’s learning journey is our top priority. Our teachers are committed to helping each student develop a love for learning. We create engaging lessons that match each child’s needs and strengths, helping them grow and succeed throughout their lives.

We believe in helping students go beyond their expectations and achieve more than they thought possible.

R Holding is a UAE-based company with a strong presence across many industries. These include real estate development, construction, hospitality and leisure, retail malls, education (including higher education), investment management, security services, and joint ventures.

Thanks to its wide range of businesses, strong regional presence, and a team of experienced professionals, R Holding has grown quickly over the past decade across different sectors.

R Holding works with well-known regional and international brands to support its growth. These partnerships help the company stay competitive and respond to changing market needs. By working with the right partners, R Holding is able to create new opportunities and deliver better results.

Corporate Social Responsibility

As a responsible organization, R Holding is committed to supporting society and addressing global challenges. The company focuses on areas such as environmental protection, health, education, and employee well-being.

Innovation and sustainability are key parts of everything R Holding does. Its CSR efforts are built around three main priorities: supporting employees, protecting the environment, and giving back to the community.

R Holding believes that diversity and inclusion are essential for long-term success. The company brings together people from different backgrounds, including various nationalities, ages, genders, and lifestyles, to build strong and skilled teams.

At GEMS FirstPoint School, learning is at the heart of everything we do. We follow the British curriculum and our experienced teachers guide students from early years all the way to sixth form. Our school community includes students from over 100 different countries, creating a truly international environment.

Our students consistently achieve strong results, often performing better than UK averages. With excellent teaching, high expectations, and opportunities for students to take initiative, we prepare them for top universities and future success.

Extracurricular Activities

Learning at FPS goes beyond the classroom. We offer a wide range of activities so every student can explore their interests. Whether it’s sports, arts, coding, leadership, or community service, there’s something for everyone.

We also work with expert organisations to provide high-quality programmes. Students are encouraged to share their ideas, so activities stay exciting and relevant. These experiences help students build confidence, discover new talents, and grow as individuals.

Family-First Approach

We believe education works best when schools and families work together. At FPS, we create a welcoming and supportive environment where every child feels valued.

We keep strong communication with parents through meetings, workshops, and regular feedback. Parents play an important role in their child’s learning journey, and many of our improvements come from their suggestions. Together, we create a positive and caring school community.

Golf Centre of Excellence

Our Golf Centre of Excellence gives students a special opportunity to combine academics with professional golf training. In partnership with leading golf experts, students receive high-level coaching and guidance.

This programme helps students develop their skills, understand the sport deeply, and even work towards scholarships or professional careers. It also focuses on balancing studies and sports for overall development.

University Pathways

FPS students achieve excellent university placements. Most graduates receive offers from top universities in the UK, USA, UAE, and Europe.

Students often choose fields like Medicine, Engineering, Law, Business, and the Arts. With strong academic results and personalised guidance, we help students confidently move toward their future careers.

Student Wellbeing

Student wellbeing is a key part of life at FPS. We ensure every child feels safe, supported, and included.

We run programmes that promote friendship, leadership, and emotional support. Trained staff and student leaders are always available to help. We regularly monitor wellbeing and provide support when needed, helping students grow into confident and balanced individuals.

Vision

Our goal is to create a learning community where every student can reach their full potential and achieve personal success.

Mission

We aim to provide high-quality British education in Dubai that meets the needs of all students and families, and becomes a preferred choice for education.

Values – Being FPS READY

We encourage students to develop important life skills:

Resilient – Work hard and never give up
Empathetic – Be kind, respectful, and understanding
Adaptable – Be open to change and new ideas
Dynamic – Be creative, curious, and confident
Be Yourself – Celebrate your unique strengths and talents
Our Culture

At FPS, we promote respect, diversity, and inclusion. We aim for strong academic success while also helping students grow personally. Our school provides many opportunities for students to develop skills, confidence, and a sense of belonging.

About Us

We are here to support your everyday journeys.

High-quality fuel and lubricants
Modern car wash facilities
Fuel storage and distribution services
Bulk fuel supply and logistics
Business and franchise opportunities

Emarat, officially known as Emirates General Petroleum Corporation, was established in 1981 in the UAE.

Our Promise

For over 40 years, we have focused on:

Delivering quality products
Offering good value
Providing friendly and efficient service

Looking Ahead

We are proud to serve the UAE and remain committed to putting customers first in everything we do.

We focus on doing things the right way from the beginning. Every project reflects our dedication to quality, thoughtful design, and strong values.

We believe in creating real spaces, not just promises.

More Than Just Construction

Mission

We deliver premium, ready-to-move-in projects that offer lasting value. Our focus is on quality, modern design, and building trust with both residents and investors in Dubai.

What Defines Us

Integrity
We work with honesty, transparency, and strong ethics in every project.

Innovation
We think ahead and design with the future in mind.

Commitment
We focus on delivering quality results before making promises.

Excellence
For us, quality is not just a goal — it is who we are.

Naas Opticals has been helping people see clearly and look great since 1998. We believe that good vision improves your daily life, and the right eyewear adds confidence and style. Over the years, we’ve grown into one of the most trusted optical stores in the UAE.

We offer a wide selection of eyewear, including eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, and stylish frames from leading brands. To become a leading name in the optical industry by opening stores in key locations across cities in the region.

Aerocorp MRO is a UAE-based company specializing in aircraft interior maintenance, refurbishment, and customization. We focus on delivering high-quality work using certified aviation materials, skilled craftsmanship, and quick turnaround times to reduce aircraft downtime.

Our goal is simple — to help airlines and aircraft owners improve their cabin interiors while keeping operations smooth and efficient.

We believe aircraft interiors should not just be practical, but also beautiful and comfortable. Every project we take on is handled with attention to detail, ensuring a perfect balance of safety, design, and performance.

Leadership
Ahmad Al Ghurair

His vision is to show that a homegrown UAE company can meet — and even exceed — global aviation standards. Under his leadership, Aerocorp combines technical expertise with dependable service, representing the region in a highly specialized industry.

Skilled professionals with strong industry experience
High standards of safety, quality, and compliance
Custom-made solutions tailored to each client
A balance of luxury, comfort, and functionality
Efficient processes that reduce downtime

We offer flexible and efficient interior solutions that help maintain aircraft value and performance.

What started as a one-person studio is now an award-winning company with a diverse team of designers from different backgrounds, all sharing a passion for detail, quality, and creativity.

Led by Leali Ezzat, the team brings strong experience and a fresh perspective to every project, shaped by years of designing and managing luxury residential spaces in the region.

From the first concept to the final result, they carefully manage every step to make sure the outcome feels complete and well thought out.

Their strength lies in turning ideas into real spaces—combining creativity, technical skill, and attention to detail to bring designs to life.

ELE Interior offers a full range of design services, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience for clients from start to finish.

We invite you to explore some of our interior design projects.

Assembly is a global marketing agency that helps brands grow using a modern, connected approach. It is part of the Stagwell network and brings together data, talented people, and technology to deliver faster and more effective results.

The team at Assembly is curious, collaborative, and always open to change. They focus on building strong brand experiences that also drive real performance. Instead of choosing between brand building and performance marketing, they believe both should work together.

Their logo includes a “+\” symbol called the ORAD, which reflects this idea of combining brand and performance.

Assembly’s work is powered by three main elements:

  • The STAGE Experience Engine, a system designed to improve marketing outcomes
  • Brand Performance Planning (BPP), their strategic approach to growth
  • A flexible team structure built for speed and modern marketing needs

By combining these, Assembly helps brands connect with people, improve engagement, and grow across areas like data, technology, media, creative work, and commerce.

With more than 3,000 experts working in 44 offices around the world, Assembly supports ambitious brands with end-to-end marketing solutions.

Diyar Private Academy in Fujairah (DPA) was founded on September 1, 2013, by H.H. Sheikh Saleh bin Mohammed bin Hamad Al Sharqi and Dr. Sheikh Mohammed bin Saleh bin Mohammed Al Sharqi. Vision

The school aims to make learning enjoyable for every child, help them love coming to school, and support them in making strong progress in their studies.

At Diyar Private Academy, the team believes that students learn best when they take an active role in their education. The school encourages learning through hands-on activities, critical thinking, and problem-solving. By offering a variety of engaging learning experiences, students build confidence, independence, and a lasting love for learning. The goal is to help students grow into flexible, confident young adults who are ready to face future challenges and make a positive impact on others.

For over 125 years, Kempinski has been welcoming guests to beautiful destinations around the world. Throughout this journey, we’ve explored new places, created new experiences, and built a strong reputation for luxury and excellence.

Our story began in 1897 with Berthold Kempinski, who started as a wine merchant in Berlin. From those humble beginnings, we have grown into one of the world’s leading luxury hotel groups, with stunning properties across several continents. While we’ve expanded globally, we continue to stay true to our roots and heritage.

Our Approach

Our guests are at the heart of everything we do. Every detail of the travel experience is carefully designed to meet their needs and expectations. We choose our locations thoughtfully and create hotels that match both our vision and our guests’ desires.

Each of our properties is unique—some are beautifully restored historic landmarks, while others are modern architectural icons. No matter the style, all our hotels reflect elegance, quality, and individuality. From relaxing spas and pools to fine dining restaurants and stylish bars, we focus on creating a complete luxury experience.

Memorable Experiences

Over the years, our hotels have welcomed celebrities, world leaders, royalty, artists, and travelers from all walks of life. They have also been the setting for unforgettable moments—romantic dinners, weddings, family holidays, and important global meetings.

But what truly makes us special is not just the rooms or facilities. It’s the experiences we create, the atmosphere we build, and the memories our guests take with them.

Our Vision

Luxury and exclusivity are central to who we are. That’s why we grow carefully, selecting only the best locations and properties that align with our brand. We continue to expand in key European destinations while also growing our presence in other parts of the world.

Our People

Our team plays a vital role in bringing our hotels to life. We invest in hiring and training talented individuals to ensure every guest receives excellent service. By sharing knowledge and maintaining high standards at every level, we create a consistent and exceptional experience.

We also believe in giving our regional teams the freedom to make decisions. This helps us deliver personalized service while respecting the culture and character of each location.

Our Commitment

As a privately owned company, we focus on long-term success rather than short-term gains. This allows us to stay true to our values, protect our heritage, and always put our guests first.

Founded in 1989, Al Ain Juniors School has grown into one of the most popular and respected schools in Al Ain. The school is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi, and is also accredited by Cambridge International Examinations, UK. It is officially recognized by the Ministry of Education in the UAE.

At Al Ain Juniors, we aim to provide a well-rounded education that supports students at every level. We encourage students to reach their full potential through academics, sports, arts, and a wide range of extracurricular activities.

We maintain high expectations for every student and work closely with parents to track progress and celebrate achievements. Our curriculum is engaging and diverse, offering learning experiences beyond the classroom through field trips, educational tours, and guest speakers.

Our teachers and staff are dedicated to continuous learning and improvement so they can support each student effectively. Along with academic growth, we strongly emphasize moral values, cultural awareness, and personal development. Respect for oneself and others is a key part of our school culture.

Learning at Al Ain Juniors is connected to the wider community, helping students grow into responsible and caring individuals. In addition to academic programs, we offer many extracurricular activities that help students develop their talents and personalities.

We aim to guide our students to become determined achievers who set meaningful goals in education, values, ethics, and personal growth.

The University of West London (UWL) is a well-known public university in the United Kingdom, respected for its high-quality teaching and strong focus on career success. It is ranked 41st in the UK by The Guardian University Guide 2026 and 5th in the UK for Student Experience by the Daily Mail University Guide 2026. UWL is often called “The Career University” because it prepares students with the skills they need to succeed in the real world.

The university is also a member of global education organizations such as the International Association of Universities and the Association of Commonwealth Universities, which reflects its strong international reputation. In 2017, UWL expanded internationally by opening a campus in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates.

About UWL – Ras Al Khaimah Campus

The University of West London’s Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) campus is located in the RAKEZ Academic Zone and offers students a chance to study a UK degree in the UAE. The campus provides programs in Business, Finance, and Computing that are designed to prepare students for global careers.

Students can choose from undergraduate and postgraduate courses such as Accounting and Finance (with ACCA accreditation), Business Studies, Computer Science, Cyber Security, MBA, MSc Cyber Security, and MSc Artificial Intelligence. All courses are taught in person by experienced and qualified faculty, combining academic learning with practical, real-world skills.

The campus is approved by the Ras Al Khaimah Department of Knowledge and follows the same academic standards as the main campus in the UK. This ensures students receive the same quality of education.

UWL RAK also focuses strongly on career development. Through its Employability Lab and Placement Cell, students get access to internships, hands-on training, and career support to help them prepare for future jobs.

The campus has received a Diamond rating in the RAKEZ–QAA UK Quality Evaluation Ranking 2023 and the RAK Department of Knowledge Quality Audit 2025, meeting all required academic standards.

As part of the Association of Commonwealth Universities and with recognition from World Education Services (WES), degrees from UWL RAK are accepted worldwide for both higher education and employment.

The university also provides support services such as accommodation, transport, and visa assistance, ensuring students have a comfortable and rewarding experience while studying in the UAE.

About Keeta

Keeta is the international branch of Meituan, a global leader in delivery services. Our mission is simple: to help people eat better and live better.

Building on 16 years of experience in technology and operations in China, we are now bringing our expertise to the world. Since launching in 2023, Keeta has been committed to creating value for everyone in the communities we serve. We focus on:

About Us

Pakistan Islamia Higher Secondary School (PIHSS), Sharjah—formerly known as Pakistan Muslim High School—was founded by Mr. Mahmood Akhtar Kiyani in September 1974. The school was established under the guidance and patronage of His Highness Sheikh Dr. Sultan Bin Mohammad Al-Qasimi, the ruler of Sharjah and a member of the Supreme Council of the UAE.

The journey started with just 150 students at the Old Al-Qasimiah Camp. The initial Board of Governors was led by Dr. Ghulam Hussain Jaffer, with Mr. Gulzar Ahmed Qureshi serving as the secretary.

In 1977, the school moved to its current campus, thanks to a generous land donation from His Highness Sheikh Muhammad Al-Qasimi, a member of the Supreme Council and the Ruler of Sharjah. With this, the school began a new chapter, becoming a Higher Secondary institution, and a new Board of Governors was formed under the leadership of Mr. Abdul Rehman Bukhatir. Group Captain Sulaiman Kiyani (late) was appointed as Principal, and Mr. Saeed-ur-Rehman took over as principal in 1978, serving for a long and successful decade.

In 1990, the school came under the management of the Consulate General of Pakistan. His Excellency Aftab Hussain Syed became the Chairman of the newly established Board of Governors. Under his leadership, the school saw significant growth in student enrollment and overall development. Today, Mr. Zahid Hussain serves as the Principal.

Our Mission and Values

  1. National Identity & Social Responsibility:
    Our aim is to foster a strong sense of national identity and social responsibility in our students, particularly within the UAE.
  2. Principles of Islam:
    We promote values like tolerance, peace, moderation, and volunteerism. Our goal is to reinforce human values through dialogue and good deeds.
  3. Commitment & Transparency:
    We are dedicated to fairness and transparency in all aspects of school operations.

At PIHSS, we strive to be an exemplary school that offers world-class education at an affordable fee structure. We believe in providing equal educational opportunities to all our students through teamwork and collaboration among staff, parents, and the community.

Our mission is to prepare students for the challenges of today and tomorrow. We work to expand the opportunities available to our students, helping them reach their full potential. By instilling a deep respect for other cultures and preserving Islamic values, we aim to build responsible, confident, and productive citizens who can contribute meaningfully to society.

About Us

Islamiya English School (IES) was established in 1978 as a private, non-profit educational institution. The school is managed by a board of directors, led by Mrs. Khadija Darwish Alqubaisi. The academic administration includes the Principal, a Deputy Director, four Department Heads, and a dedicated team of highly qualified teachers, all recognized by the Department of Education and Knowledge in Abu Dhabi.

IES is licensed under the UAE’s economic sector (License No. CN-1000988) and educational sector (License No. 64-9109), operating as Islamiya English School L.L.C. We have built a strong, skilled faculty capable of offering excellent academic support, helping students discover their strengths, and preparing them for the future. Our teachers are trained not only to educate but also to guide students in personal development, leadership, and growth, using the latest educational tools available.

Our Key Features

  1. Highly Qualified Teachers:
    Our teaching staff is composed of highly qualified educators from around the world.
  2. International Curriculum:
    We follow an international syllabus that prepares students for global challenges.
  3. World-Class Facilities:
    The school is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, ensuring that students have access to everything they need to succeed.
  4. Science Laboratories:
    We have fully equipped science labs where students can engage in hands-on experiments and enhance their learning.
  5. Playground Facilities:
    Physical health is a priority at IES. Our spacious playgrounds support a variety of sports and outdoor activities.
  6. Library:
    Our library boasts a large collection of books, offering students a wealth of knowledge and resources.
  7. Computer Labs:
    In today’s digital world, technology is essential. Our computer labs provide students with the tools to develop their digital skills.
  8. IES Clubs:
    The school offers a variety of clubs and extracurricular activities, helping students explore their interests and talents outside of the classroom.

Our Legacy

Islamiya English School was founded by the late Darwish Bin Karam Abdulla Alqubaisi, who had a vision of creating a school in Abu Dhabi that offered quality education at an affordable price. After his passing, his family took over the school to continue his legacy, ensuring that his vision for accessible education lived on.

Today, Mrs. Khadija Darwish Alqubaisi chairs the school’s board and is one of the school’s owners. The administration team, including the Principal, Deputy Director, and Department Heads, is made up of experienced and qualified professionals who were selected for their expertise and dedication to education.

We are proud of our history and are committed to providing high-quality education and personal development for all our students.

Construction General Contracting House Ltd.

Established in 1990, CGC House is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certified company. Over the years, it has grown to become one of the leading groups of companies in Abu Dhabi, UAE, with the following businesses under its umbrella:

Construction General Contracting House Ltd.
Construction House Transportation LLC
Construction House Real Estate LLC
Castilla Building Materials LLC

The competitive construction market in the UAE has shaped CGC House into a highly professional company that approaches every project with care and precision. The company uses a strategic, flexible approach to adapt to each project’s specific conditions, client needs, contracts, and deadlines.

The management team uses both traditional and modern techniques in construction, combining their experience and knowledge to deliver the best value for clients.

The leadership of CGC House consists of qualified engineers with years of experience in the Gulf and Middle East regions. These engineers are supported by skilled professionals who ensure quality at every stage. The company’s project management includes organized purchasing, scheduling, computerized drafting, quality control, and a dedicated team to service completed projects.

CGC House is committed to delivering projects with the highest standards of quality and safety, always complying with local regulations as well as client and contract requirements.

CGC House’s Mission

Our mission is to provide environmentally friendly construction services of the highest quality. We aim to exceed our customers’ expectations and meet or beat all project schedules through top-notch construction services.

CGC House’s Philosophy of Client Service

At CGC House, we believe that safety, quality service, and delivering superior products and workmanship are the cornerstones of our philosophy. These principles guide us as we move forward and continue to grow.

We focus on quality because it is essential to our success. By setting high standards and ensuring efficiency and cost-effectiveness while staying true to the design vision, CGC House achieves success for clients and consistently delivers excellent results.

Welcome to SAMA International School – Galileo Campus

SAMA International School – Galileo Campus, located in Khalifa City, Abu Dhabi, is the founding campus of the SAMA International Schools Group. We offer a high-quality American curriculum, aligned with California/Common Core standards, enriched with the International Baccalaureate (IB) approach, and complemented by a trilingual program in English, Arabic, and Italian.

At SAMA, education goes beyond books and classrooms. We aim to nurture confident, responsible, and globally aware students, equipping them with the skills and mindset to succeed in a rapidly changing world.

Our school is recognized internationally for excellence. We are an IB World School (PYP & MYP), a Candidate for the Career-related Programme (CP), a member of CIS, and are progressing towards CIS and NEASC accreditations.

Our Vision

Inspiring excellence, empowering minds, shaping global citizens

We strive to be a globally respected school that develops ethical leaders, critical thinkers, and compassionate individuals ready to thrive in a fast-changing world.

Our Mission

Excellence through innovation, diversity, and global education

SAMA International School provides a transformative learning experience through the American curriculum, guided by IB philosophies. We focus on academic achievement, student wellbeing, and international mindedness, while valuing cultural diversity and personal learning pathways.

Respect – Appreciating diversity, cultures, and perspectives

Collaboration – Working together to reach shared goals

American Curriculum with a Global Perspective
Strong academic foundations enhanced by inquiry, critical thinking, and IB-inspired learning.

Co-curricular programs that encourage leadership, creativity, and personal growth.

Modern Facilities
Purpose-built spaces and technology-enabled classrooms that enhance learning.

International Standards
IB World School (PYP & MYP) • CP Candidate • Progressing towards CIS & NEASC accreditation

Our Story

At Dr. Firas Dental, we are passionate about creating smiles that make a difference. Our clinic combines advanced technology with personalized care to deliver exceptional dental services. We specialize in Cosmetic Dentistry, Orthodontics, Laser Treatments, Bone Augmentation, and Dental Implants.

Our team works closely with you to design a treatment plan that helps you achieve the natural, confident smile you’ve always wanted. Every patient is treated with care, respect, and attention to detail—because your smile is our priority.

Our Vision

To provide dental care in a safe, modern environment and to become the UAE’s leading dental center known for innovative technology and advanced treatments.

Our Mission

We aim to improve the lives of our patients through high-quality dental care. Our goal is to build lasting relationships based on honesty, ethics, and personalized attention, ensuring every patient feels valued and supported.

Our Values
Quality – We strive to exceed standards, delivering care that is timely, effective, and tailored to each patient.
Compassion – Every interaction is guided by empathy, honesty, and genuine care.
Respect – We honor every individual and value the unique perspectives they bring.
Collaboration – We work together across our team and with patients’ families to provide integrated, thoughtful care.
Foresight – We anticipate challenges and innovate solutions to promote healthier communities.
Our Commitment to Patients
Life, Health, and Wellbeing – Your safety and overall health are our top priority. We provide care that meets the highest standards while respecting your individual circumstances.
Comfortable, Effective Treatment – Treatments are planned to match your age, health, and specific dental needs, aiming for pain-free and effective outcomes.
Patient Choice – You have the right to make informed decisions about your treatment. Our team provides guidance and information, but the choice is always yours.

Fairness – We welcome everyone, without discrimination, and treat each patient equally.

Welcome to Emirates National Schools

We are happy to welcome you to Emirates National Schools (ENS). At ENS, we aim to create a safe and supportive environment where every student and staff member feels valued, respected, and included. We believe every individual matters, and we work together to help everyone grow, succeed, and feel a strong sense of belonging.

ENS was established in 2002 by a Presidential Decree, with its first campus in Mohammed Bin Zayed City. Over the years, it has expanded to six campuses across the UAE, including Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Dubai, Sharjah, and Ras Al Khaimah.

Our schools offer internationally recognized programs through the International Baccalaureate (IB) framework, including the Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP), and Diploma Programme (DP). We also follow American Common Core Standards in English, Math, and Science, and offer Advanced Placement (AP) courses for senior students. In addition, we teach UAE Ministry of Education subjects such as Arabic, Islamic Studies, and UAE Social Studies.

Under the guidance of H.H. Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan, ENS has grown into a leading model of education in the country. We focus on developing students’ character, strengthening their identity, and preparing them for a fast-changing world. We also provide hands-on learning opportunities through modern facilities and offer programs like scholarships and summer camps for talented students.

Our teachers and staff come from diverse backgrounds and work together to provide a high-quality learning experience. We value strong partnerships with parents and the community, as they play an important role in supporting student success.

At ENS, we believe that all students can achieve their goals with the right support. We encourage teamwork, open discussion, and continuous learning among both students and staff. Our goal is to help every child reach their full potential.

We focus on building leadership skills in both students and teachers. We celebrate diversity and support every learner in their own unique way. Our schools promote a culture of collaboration where everyone is known, supported, and encouraged.

We want our students to lead meaningful and happy lives beyond school. We aim to inspire their interests and passions so they can make a positive difference in the world.

Our Vision
To prepare future leaders through innovative education while respecting and preserving cultural heritage.

Our Mission
To provide high-quality education that builds strong character, uses technology effectively, and prepares students to become responsible leaders and active members of their communities.

Abdul Wahed Bin Shabib Group of Companies has more than 40 years of experience in construction, real estate, hospitality, and healthcare. We are dedicated to delivering quality work, embracing new ideas, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

Over the years, we have built strong relationships with our clients and partners by providing dependable and high-quality services. We aim to grow responsibly while supporting the community and contributing to the economy.

Our work is guided by our core values—integrity, excellence, and continuous improvement. We believe in being honest, responsible, and always looking for ways to improve what we do.

Our Heritage and Growth

Since starting in 1981, the group has grown from a small family business into a company with a presence in several industries.

Our growth has come from making smart decisions, exploring new ideas, and staying focused on delivering the best. Today, we are proud of our journey and continue working toward a stronger future.

Commitment to Innovation

Innovation is an important part of our work. We are always searching for better ways to improve our services and create more value for our clients.

By using modern technology and keeping up with industry changes, we make sure our projects are efficient and ready for the future. We also invest in research and development to create solutions that meet current needs and future challenges.

Our Vision

Building a Sustainable Future through Innovation and Integrity

Our aim is to become a global leader in our industries by providing high-quality, sustainable, and innovative solutions.

We want to create long-term value for everyone we work with while making a positive impact on the communities around us.

About Marvel International School

Marvel International School (MIS) was established in 2018. We are a fully accredited school, recognized as a center for Edexcel, AQA, and Cambridge exams, including IGCSE, AS, and A-Level qualifications. We follow the British education system, using both the Cambridge and EYFS National Curriculum frameworks. Our school caters to children aged 2 years and 8 months to 18 years old, with classes ranging from Nursery to Year 12.

Our Vision

At Marvel International School, we aim to create a community that nurtures lifelong learners who strive for academic and personal excellence. We focus on helping our students make a positive difference in the world by promoting global citizenship, respecting Egyptian heritage, and living by our core values: Respect, Integrity, Compassion, and Perseverance.

Our Mission

Marvel’s mission is to celebrate each student’s unique passion and support their growth in every area: intellectual, social, physical, and moral. We are committed to high standards and believe in working closely with our students, teachers, and parents to create a supportive and successful learning environment.

Our Curriculum

  • EYFS (Early Years Foundation Stage) follows the National Curriculum of England. This includes 7 key areas:
    • Literacy
    • Mathematics
    • Communication and Language
    • Understanding the World
    • Physical Development
    • Personal, Social & Emotional Development
    • Expressive Arts & Design
  • Primary and Secondary Stages follow the Cambridge Framework, which provides flexibility in developing skills and knowledge across several subjects. These include:
    • English (First Language)
    • Mathematics
    • Science
    • Humanities (in Primary)
    • Cambridge Global Perspectives

In addition, all students study a variety of non-core subjects, such as:

  • Art
  • Physical Education (P.E.)
  • Music
  • ICT
  • French or German (starting from Primary level)
  • Arabic
  • Religion (except EYFS)
  • Arabic Social Studies (for Years 4 to 10)
  • Pastoral Care

Dubai Chocolate has become a huge trend online, with millions of views and shares across social media. People everywhere are loving the famous Pistachio Kunafa Chocolate, known for its crunchy texture and rich Middle Eastern dessert taste. Many describe it as having the same satisfying crispiness as kunafa.

At Choco Zen, we saw this growing trend and created our own version of Dubai Chocolate at just the right time. Today, our chocolates are available in leading supermarkets and retail stores across the UAE, bringing this viral sensation to chocolate lovers everywhere.

What We Do

At Choco Zen, we create chocolates that combine tradition with new ideas. Our goal is to offer unique flavors inspired by both global and Middle Eastern desserts.

We believe great chocolate comes from creativity. Our team is always experimenting with new flavors, fillings, and textures to find the perfect combination. From rich and creamy centers to crunchy surprises, every product is designed to be exciting and enjoyable.

We also make sure our chocolates are easy to find. By being available in major retail stores, we make it simple for everyone to enjoy Choco Zen. Whether you like classic tastes or want to try something different, there’s something for everyone.

What We Value

At Choco Zen, every bite is made to bring happiness.

Children begin Kindergarten (KG1) in September once they turn 3 years old. This stage lasts for two years.

The Kindergarten program follows the US Common Core State Standards and the Core Knowledge Sequence, which focus on building strong basic learning skills in a simple and effective way. Science lessons are aligned with the Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).

Students learn Arabic, whether they are native or non-native speakers. Muslim students also study Islamic Studies based on Ministry of Education (MoE) guidelines.

The curriculum uses an integrated approach, where subjects like science and social studies are connected with other areas of learning and taught through themed units over several weeks. Along with this, children receive focused lessons in English, Arts, and Mathematics.

Skills are developed through a variety of topics, helping children apply what they learn in different situations.

Elementary School (Grade 1 to Grade 5)

Elementary School is a five-year stage that follows Kindergarten.

The learning environment is carefully designed to support young learners, with well-equipped classrooms that include interactive whiteboards and modern educational tools. Students take part in hands-on, activity-based learning that engages all their senses.

Class teachers handle most subjects, while specialist teachers teach Arabic, Islamic Studies (for Muslim students), UAE Social Studies, Music, and Physical Education. There are also dedicated rooms for ICT, Music, and PE.

The English Language Arts program helps students improve their speaking, writing, and listening skills. It focuses on accuracy, fluency, and understanding, with special attention given to different types of writing. Students also complete projects to deepen their learning.

Mathematics is taught in a way that connects concepts to real-life situations, and the science curriculum follows NGSS standards.

Learning is enriched through field trips, guest speakers, events, performances, and school celebrations.

Students study Science, Social Studies, and PSHCE through integrated lessons that encourage curiosity, active participation, and the development of 21st-century skills. The curriculum is designed to be language-rich, practical, and suitable for individual learning needs.

Middle School (Grade 6 to Grade 8)

Middle School is a three-year stage that prepares students for High School.

The program focuses on inquiry-based learning, encouraging students to ask questions, explore ideas, and think independently. It is based on Virginia standards and modern teaching methods that prepare students for future challenges.

English is the main language of instruction, except for Arabic, Islamic Studies, and UAE Social Studies, which are taught in Arabic as required by the Ministry of Education.

The curriculum follows Common Core State Standards (CCSS) for English and Mathematics, and NGSS for Science. These standards are research-based, internationally aligned, and designed to develop higher-order thinking skills.

Students are encouraged to build confidence, leadership skills, and personal talents through extracurricular activities and elective subjects such as ICT, Computer Programming, French, and Music.

Arabic is compulsory for all students, and Islamic Studies is required for Muslim students. Classrooms are well-equipped with modern technology to support learning.

Teaching combines traditional methods with innovative approaches. Students participate in presentations, projects, and special activities. They also use multimedia tools to enhance their learning.

The focus is on active participation, independent thinking, and developing critical thinking skills while maintaining a balanced academic workload.

High School (Grade 9 to Grade 12)

High School is a four-year stage where students are taught by subject specialists.

The program provides strong academic training while encouraging independence, responsibility, and deeper thinking. Learning is supported through educational trips, guest visits, performances, and school events. Students can also join extracurricular activities after school.

Core subjects required for the US diploma include English, Mathematics, Science (with laboratory work), History and Social Studies, Health and Physical Education, Arabic, and Fine Arts & Technology.

Students study core subjects like English, Math, and Science in greater depth, building on what they have already learned. Each year, they also choose two elective subjects based on their interests.

Assessment is continuous throughout the year, and progress reports are shared with parents three times annually.

Subjects offered include:

English Language Arts
Arabic Studies
Mathematics
General Science
Physics, Chemistry, Biology
Islamic Studies (for Muslim students)
Social Studies / UAE Social Studies / Civics
World Languages
Art and Design
Music
Physical Education
World History
Business Studies
Personal Finance

At The Royal Academy, we focus on keeping students up to date with modern teaching methods and learning strategies. Our goal is to give every child the best possible education.

We help students build confidence, self-esteem, and healthy, ethical habits. The school creates a supportive and diverse environment where students enjoy learning and develop curiosity that lasts a lifetime. Campus and Environment

The school is known as one of the first eco-friendly schools in Ajman, Sharjah, and Umm Al Quwain. It promotes love for nature and encourages students to take part in environmental activities and projects. This helps them develop responsibility towards the environment and society.

The Royal Academy is home to students from over 40 nationalities. It celebrates cultural diversity and teaches students to respect and understand different backgrounds. This creates a friendly and inclusive community where everyone feels accepted.

Learning Approach

Students are involved in real-world learning through activities like group projects, creative thinking tasks, and team challenges. The school also focuses on social and emotional development, helping students build communication skills, teamwork, and resilience.

This approach helps students develop not only intelligence but also emotional and social awareness, preparing them for real-life situations.

Vision

Mission
Provide: A curriculum that is global in outlook while still respecting traditions and values.
Raise: Students who are positive, kind, and emotionally strong.
Enable: Skills for future careers through technology and real-world learning experiences.
Prepare: Students to become leaders who care for people and the environment.
Articulate: A multicultural environment where respect and understanding are valued.
Recognise: Every child as unique, with their own strengths and potential for success.
Empower: Students to make decisions and use their knowledge to contribute to society.

Our Mission
Our mission is to create a safe, engaging, and stimulating environment where students enjoy learning, stay curious, reach their full potential, and grow into independent, lifelong learners and responsible future leaders. We value every student and welcome everyone in our inclusive community. By working closely with parents and the community, we provide learning experiences that are meaningful both inside and outside the classroom.

Our Vision
Our vision is to inspire each child to be curious, thoughtful, and innovative. We aim to equip them with skills and knowledge for the future while fostering an appreciation for culture, diversity, and values, preparing them to thrive as global citizens.

Shaping a Better Tomorrow
We encourage students to learn enthusiastically and confidently through high-quality teaching and a challenging curriculum. This helps them develop self-respect, respect for others, leadership, and creativity—qualities that positively influence those around them.

The Amity Graduate
An Amity graduate combines knowledge, empathy, and leadership. They show respect, courtesy, and determination in everything they do. With hard work, cooperation, and creativity, they build confidence, kindness, self-reliance, and a strong focus on achieving their goals.

content.rendered:
The Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah is known for its rich history, beautiful mountains, beaches, and unique culture. It also offers a great environment for higher education.

The American University of Ras Al Khaimah (AURAK) is a public, non-profit university that offers coeducation for students from around the world. Its large and modern campus provides American-style undergraduate and graduate programs, while also respecting and reflecting local culture.

AURAK works closely with leading organizations both regionally and internationally. These partnerships help students gain practical experience and develop the skills needed to succeed in their careers globally.

The university is also committed to sustainability. It avoids investing in fossil fuels and instead supports eco-friendly initiatives and the local community. This shows AURAK’s dedication to protecting the environment and building a better future.

With students from over 45 nationalities, AURAK offers a diverse and multicultural environment. This helps students learn how to work and live in a global society.

At AURAK, students are encouraged not only to study but also to enjoy campus life. They can join clubs, sports teams, and events, helping them build friendships and grow personally and professionally.

Learning and Teaching Culture

AURAK focuses on student-centered learning, where students actively participate in their education. Teachers use modern teaching methods such as group projects, research work, internships, and writing-based courses to help students understand and apply what they learn.

Community service is also an important part of education at AURAK. Students are encouraged to give back to society while developing their knowledge and skills.

The university promotes respect, integrity, and open communication. Everyone on campus is expected to treat each other with kindness and fairness. AURAK supports freedom of thought and encourages students to share ideas and learn from different perspectives.

Accreditations and Recognition

AURAK is officially approved by the UAE Ministry of Education to offer higher education degrees. It is also accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC), allowing it to award bachelor’s and master’s degrees.

In addition, AURAK has received recognition from international organizations such as the UK’s Quality Assurance Agency (QAA) and the UAE’s Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA).

The university offers a wide range of programs in fields like Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Media, Education, and Biotechnology.

Many of its engineering programs are accredited by ABET, ensuring they meet global industry standards. The Biotechnology program is also accredited by ABET’s Applied and Natural Science Accreditation Commission.

The School of Business is connected with AACSB International, a well-known global organization for business education. It is also part of the Business Education Alliance.

Finance students benefit from affiliation with the CFA Institute, while Accounting and Finance programs offer ACCA exemptions, giving students an advantage in their careers.

The Architecture program has also received recognition from the National Architectural Accrediting Board (NAAB).

Vision

To become a globally recognized university that prepares future-ready graduates through quality education, innovation, and lifelong learning.

Mission

To develop future leaders by providing student-focused education, connecting academic learning with real-world experience, and encouraging research and innovation that benefits society.

Tagline

Life-Changing Education. Global Impact.

Core Values (IDEALS)

Integrity
Always acting with honesty and strong ethical values.

Diversity and Inclusiveness
Creating an environment where everyone feels welcome and respected.

Excellence
Striving for the highest standards in teaching, research, and service.

Academic Freedom
Encouraging open thinking, discussion, and sharing of ideas.

Lifelong Learning
Supporting continuous growth and learning for all.

Sustainability
Caring for the environment and ensuring a better future for coming generations.

Louzan Group is a company that works in different areas of Arabic fashion and lifestyle. The brand focuses on keeping traditional Arabic culture alive while also bringing in modern style and ideas.

The journey of Louzan Group started in the UAE in August 2003 with a small showroom in Al Ain called “High Lady Sheila & Abaya.” At that time, the business mainly produced and sold women’s abayas. The team was small, with only three showroom staff and six skilled workers in the workshop.

Just a few months later, in October 2003, the company launched its first luxury brand, “Louzan Sheila & Abaya.” This step marked an upgrade in quality, design, and brand image, while continuing the same core business.

Know More About Us

Today, Louzan Group is a well-known retail company with a range of luxury brands that meet the fashion and lifestyle needs of customers across the GCC.

Louzan is an award-winning brand in the Arabian Gulf. It offers stylish collections for both women and men, inspired by modern elegance while respecting cultural values like privacy and modesty.

The products are designed for today’s customers and are suitable for everyday wear, formal occasions, and special events. The brand uses high-quality materials such as fine fabrics and genuine leather, combined with expert tailoring to create unique and elegant designs that blend tradition with modern fashion.

Louzan Group has grown into a leading luxury retailer in the Middle East, with more than 45 stores located in major shopping malls across the UAE and Oman.

The Meaning Behind the Name “Louzan”

The name “Louzan” comes from Lausanne, a historic city in Switzerland known for its beauty, culture, and strong respect for tradition.

By choosing this name, the brand reflects its core idea: combining traditional values with modern fashion and innovation. This balance has helped Louzan grow and stand out in both local and international markets.

Growth and Expansion

Louzan Group has grown steadily over the years with a clear vision for success. In May 2005, the company opened its first factory in Al Ain. This was an important step that allowed the business to produce its own products, improve quality, and serve customers better.

Even during challenging economic times, the company stayed strong and flexible. It continued to develop new ideas and introduce modern Arabic fashion styles that connected well with its customers.

Brand Diversification

In June 2015, Louzan Group expanded further by launching “Cavallo Collection,” an international luxury fashion brand inspired by Arabic culture.

After receiving a positive response from customers, the brand expanded to several locations across the UAE. The Group also introduced new product categories such as perfumes, accessories, and even food and beverage concepts. This helped Louzan create a complete lifestyle experience for its customers, along with high-quality service.

Vision

To become the leading choice in Arabic fashion and lifestyle by staying ahead and shaping the future.

Mission

To deliver great value to customers by building a passionate team, encouraging creativity, and continuously improving products and services.

Who We Are
Royal Jet LLC is a leading private aviation company based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The company is chaired by His Excellency Mohammed Alardhi and is recognized globally for its premium private jet services.
Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, Royal Jet operates from its own VIP terminal (FBO) at Zayed International Airport. The company meets high international standards and holds several certifications from aviation authorities in the UAE, Guernsey, and San Marino.
Royal Jet manages and operates a modern fleet that includes Boeing Business Jets and Bombardier Global aircraft. The company offers a wide range of services such as private jet charter, aircraft management, leasing, medical evacuation flights, aircraft brokerage, and maintenance. As a founding member of the Middle East Business Aviation Association (MEBAA), Royal Jet plays an important role in the aviation industry. It is also a member of other global aviation organizations. Its operations are certified by the International Business Aviation Council (IBAC) and follow the Wyvern Wingman safety program. In addition, its VIP terminal is part of the well-known Air Elite Network.
Royal Jet has received several awards over the years, including multiple wins for “World’s Leading Private Jet Charter” at the World Travel Awards. Its VIP terminal has also been recognized for its high-quality facilities and excellent service.

South London and Maudsley NHS Foundation Trust, also known as the Maudsley, is one of the world’s leading organizations in mental health care, research, and education. Based in London, the Maudsley has more than 700 years of experience in providing high-quality mental health services. It is recognized as the oldest psychiatric institution in the world and one of Europe’s top centers for psychiatric research and treatment.

The organization has around 5,000 staff members from different professional backgrounds, including psychiatrists, nurses, psychologists, psychotherapists, occupational therapists, social workers, and clinical scientists. Together, they provide a wide range of mental health and addiction treatment services across the United Kingdom.

The Maudsley is also part of King’s Health Partners, one of England’s leading Academic Health Science Centres. This partnership brings together experts from King’s College London, the Institute of Psychiatry, Psychology and Neuroscience (IoPPN), and major NHS hospitals. This close collaboration helps turn research findings into better treatments for patients both in the UK and around the world.

The IoPPN is Europe’s largest center for research and postgraduate education in psychiatry, psychology, and neuroscience. Its strong connection with the Maudsley allows new discoveries and research to directly improve patient care and mental health services internationally.

The Trust is also involved in advanced genomics and medical research, including participation in the UK’s 100,000 Genomes Project, helping to improve understanding and treatment of mental health conditions.

The Maudsley is highly respected worldwide for its excellent psychiatric training programs. Many professionals trained at the Maudsley have gone on to hold senior clinical and academic positions across the UK and internationally.

College and Career Readiness

Preparing students for university studies and future careers.

Our Story

At The Espresso Lab, coffee is more than just a drink — it is a passion and a craft. Founded by Emirati entrepreneur Ibrahim Al Mallouhi, the company was created with a deep love for specialty coffee and a commitment to quality, creativity, and authentic coffee experiences.

From the beginning, the goal has been simple: to serve exceptional coffee made with care, precision, and attention to detail. Every cup reflects the team’s dedication to craftsmanship and innovation.

As the brand continues to grow, The Espresso Lab remains focused on exploring new ideas and improving the specialty coffee experience. Through advanced brewing methods, modern technology, and seasonal coffee selections, the company introduces customers to unique flavors and memorable coffee moments.

The Espresso Lab also aims to create a welcoming space where coffee lovers, friends, and families can connect and enjoy high-quality coffee together.

How the Journey Began

Founder Ibrahim Al Mallouhi discovered his love for coffee at a young age while watching his grandmother carefully roast traditional Arabic coffee. Those early experiences taught him to appreciate the art, aroma, and flavor of coffee.

As Dubai’s coffee culture grew, Ibrahim searched for a deeper and more authentic coffee experience. In 2010, during a visit to New York, he discovered a specialty coffee shop that completely changed his perspective on coffee. Inspired by this experience, he began exploring specialty coffee around the world.

Over the next five years, he traveled to different countries, visiting coffee shops and learning about coffee production and brewing techniques. He also completed professional coffee training at Bellissimo Coffee Advisors in Oregon, becoming a certified barista and coffee professional.

His journey took him to coffee-producing countries such as Vietnam and Ethiopia, where he worked closely with farmers to better understand the coffee process from farm to cup.

To turn his vision into a successful business, Ibrahim later completed an Executive MBA at CASS Business School in London. With a strong vision, passion, and commitment to quality, The Espresso Lab was officially launched in Dubai.

Crafting the Ultimate Coffee Experience

The Espresso Lab is dedicated to creating outstanding coffee experiences for every customer. The team believes in sharing their passion for coffee through friendly service, education, and creativity.

Innovation plays an important role in everything they do. The team continuously experiments with new brewing methods, roasting techniques, and coffee selections to create exciting and unique flavors.

The process begins with carefully sourcing high-quality microlot coffees from around the world. Each coffee bean is roasted with precision to highlight its best flavors and characteristics.

Whether customers enjoy espresso, drip coffee, or cold brew, every cup is prepared with attention to detail and tailored to deliver the best possible taste experience.

Beyond serving great coffee, The Espresso Lab also values the hard work of coffee farmers and aims to honor their dedication by showcasing the true quality and character of every coffee crop.

About The Sheikh Zayed Private Academy for Boys

The Sheikh Zayed Private Academy for Boys (SZPAB) is one of the leading and most respected schools in Abu Dhabi. Located in the center of the city, the school opened in 2015 and continues the legacy of The Sheikh Zayed Private Academy for Girls, which was established in 2000 following the vision of the late H.H. Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan.

Most of the students at SZPAB are Emirati, and many families choose the school because of its strong focus on preserving UAE culture and traditions while preparing students for the future. The school’s guiding message, “Honoring the past. Educating for the future.”, is reflected in everyday learning and school life.

SZPAB follows a blended curriculum that combines the American Massachusetts State Common Core Curriculum with the UAE Ministry of Education Curriculum. Students also study programs such as UAE Social Studies and My Identity, helping them stay connected to their national identity and values.

One of the school’s most unique programs is the Eyal Zayed Program, developed in partnership with the UAE Armed Forces. This program helps students build leadership skills, discipline, teamwork, loyalty, and a sense of responsibility and service to their community and country.

The school is internationally accredited by CIS and NEASC and is approved by the College Board to offer Advanced Placement (AP) courses. SZPAB has also received an “Outstanding” rating in the ADEK Irtiqaa inspection program and was recognized as an “Outstanding School” for National Identity in the 2022–2023 academic year.

At SZPAB, students are encouraged to achieve academic excellence, develop strong character, and become confident future leaders while staying connected to their heritage and values.

Our Journey

1948 – A New Beginning in the UK

Our story started in 1948 when the Sunner family moved from Punjab, India, to the United Kingdom. Like many immigrant families, they arrived with very little but carried a strong determination to build a better future. Through hard work, honesty, and dedication, they began working in factories and laid the foundation for what would become a successful family business.

1955 – Opening One of the First Ethnic Retail Stores

In 1955, the family opened one of the UK's first ethnic retail stores. The shop provided authentic products to Indian and Caribbean communities who were looking for familiar foods and goods from home. Over time, the business grew into a respected retail chain and became a trusted destination for multicultural communities across the country.

1999 – The Launch of Matchworkers International

Inspired by the family's entrepreneurial spirit, Joe Sunner founded Matchworkers International in 1999. The company became a pioneer in international recruitment by helping skilled hospitality workers from India secure legal employment opportunities in the UK. This innovative approach supported both workers seeking better opportunities and employers facing staff shortages.

Since then, Matchworkers International has built a reputation for trust, professionalism, and ethical recruitment.

2023 – Expanding into Greece

In 2023, Matchworkers International entered the Greek market and introduced seasonal hospitality recruitment services. After extensive planning and navigating complex regulations, the company successfully established operations in Thessaloniki, with expansion into other major cities soon following.

This milestone allowed us to connect more employers with skilled workers while creating valuable international career opportunities.

Today – Innovation in Recruitment

Today, Matchworkers International continues to grow and innovate. We are proud to offer a unique "Hire Now, Pay Later" recruitment solution, helping businesses access the talent they need while providing flexible recruitment options.

Although our services have evolved, our purpose remains the same: connecting reliable employers with hardworking people and creating opportunities that change lives.

Growing Our Presence in Greece

Following the success of our Thessaloniki operations, we are expanding further across Greece with new offices in Athens and Crete. This growth allows us to better serve employers throughout the country and strengthen our support for both businesses and workers.

Royse Furniture is a leading manufacturer of high-quality furniture for hotels, resorts, restaurants, cafés, bars, and outdoor hospitality spaces. With more than 30 years of experience, we have built a strong reputation as one of the UAE’s largest furniture manufacturers and exporters.

We specialize in creating stylish, durable, and customized furniture solutions tailored to the unique needs of hospitality projects across the UAE and GCC. From design and production to delivery and installation, we are committed to providing exceptional products and services that help bring hospitality spaces to life.

Our Journey

Since our founding in Dubai in 1996, Royse Furniture has continued to grow and expand its capabilities:

  • 1996 – Royse Group was established in Dubai, UAE.
  • 1997 – Expanded operations with the launch of a foam manufacturing facility.
  • 1998 – Opened offices in Oman, India, and China, extending our international presence.
  • 1999 – Added mattress manufacturing to our growing product range.
  • 2009 – Opened a large production facility and became one of the UAE’s leading foam and furniture manufacturers.
  • 2012 – Entered the joinery sector with a dedicated factory for custom project work.
  • 2013 – Expanded operations through the production of non-woven fabric.
  • 2016 – Introduced a premium bedding collection.
  • 2020 – Invested in advanced CNC technology to improve production efficiency and precision.
  • 2021 – Expanded into large-scale manufacturing of metal, upholstered, and wooden furniture with a state-of-the-art facility.

Our Expertise

Today, Royse Furniture supports hospitality projects of all sizes by providing:

  • Custom furniture design and manufacturing
  • Hotel room furniture solutions
  • Restaurant and café furniture
  • Outdoor furniture collections
  • Upholstered, wooden, and metal furniture
  • Bedding and mattress solutions
  • Delivery and installation services

Large-Scale Manufacturing

Our production facility in Ras Al Khaimah spans over one million square feet, making it one of the largest furniture manufacturing facilities in the UAE. This allows us to efficiently handle large hospitality projects while maintaining high standards of quality.

Quality You Can Trust

Our experienced quality control team oversees every stage of production, from design approval to final installation, ensuring every product meets strict quality standards.

Reliable Project Delivery

Strong After-Sales Support

We are committed to long-term customer satisfaction and provide dependable after-sales support to ensure every project continues to perform as expected.

By the Numbers

As a subsidiary of Al Jomaih Holding Company, we are committed to supporting sustainable growth through reliable utility and infrastructure solutions.

We manage projects throughout their entire lifecycle—from planning and development to construction, operation, and long-term management. By working with experienced industry partners, we deliver innovative solutions that meet the growing demand for energy and water.

Our portfolio includes conventional and renewable power plants, desalination facilities, and industrial wastewater treatment projects. Together, these projects help improve essential infrastructure while supporting the long-term development of the communities we serve.

Today, we have an energy generation capacity of approximately 13 GW, including combined-cycle gas turbine (CCGT), cogeneration, and solar power projects. We also manage water projects with a total capacity of around 1.3 million cubic meters per day, covering independent water production, water and power, and water treatment facilities.

Since 2018, we have successfully secured and developed several major power and water projects across Saudi Arabia, Oman, Egypt, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. With a growing team of experienced professionals and regional offices, we continue to expand our presence and deliver high-quality infrastructure projects that create lasting value.

Most businesses don’t struggle because of lack of effort— they struggle because they don’t have financial clarity when it matters most. In many SMEs, finance is often considered only as accounting and compliance. But in reality, finance is much broader—it requires strong foundations, structured systems, reliable reporting, financial visibility, and the ability to turn numbers into better business decisions. At the same time, business owners often lack the time or expertise to evaluate whether their finance function is truly operating at its full potential. As a result, businesses are not able to realize their full potential and operate with limited visibility, make decisions without reliable data, and struggle to scale efficiently. Our Mission To bring CFO-level financial leadership to growing businesses in a way that is practical, structured, and scalable—without the cost and complexity of a full-time CFO setup. Our Approach Most advisory starts with strategy. But strategy built on weak financial foundations rarely works. We take a different approach. We work across the entire finance function—from building a strong foundation to enabling strategic decision-making—depending on what the business needs at each stage. From getting the numbers right, to building structure and reporting, to creating real-time visibility through automation and tools like Power BI, and ultimately supporting planning, decisions, and growth. While many firms focus primarily on financial strategy, we ensure the entire finance function is aligned—from foundations to decision-making. Today, we partner with growing businesses to bring clarity, control, and confidence to their financial decisions.

About KPMG Middle East LLP

KPMG Middle East LLP is part of the global KPMG network of independent professional firms affiliated with KPMG International Limited.

The firm provides audit, tax, and advisory services to public and private sector organizations across the Middle East. Its operations cover Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Jordan, Lebanon, Oman, and Iraq, with services delivered through separate legal entities in each country.

With around 5,000 professionals and more than 50 years of experience in the region, KPMG has grown into one of the leading professional services organizations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Globally, KPMG International connects independent member firms across 154 countries, creating a broad network of professionals and expertise.

KPMG Middle East LLP itself does not provide services directly to clients or enter into client engagements. Instead, services are delivered by the appropriate KPMG member firm operating in the relevant country.

Our Services

  • Audit and assurance
  • Tax services
  • Advisory and consulting
  • Professional support for public and private sector organizations

KPMG combines international expertise with strong regional knowledge to support organizations in addressing their business needs and making informed decisions.
